The tests are easy if you go to class, and his textbook is the modified version compared to the other LEB professor's textbooks. Open note and book tests.

Hilarious professor with incredibly engaging lectures that I not only actively listened to, but genuinely enjoyed going to. Highly recommend that you go to all the lectures, as the test questions typically have stuff ripped from lectures (e.g. "The conclusion that we determined in class regarding the means principle of the Trolley Problem was...")

by far my favorite professor at UT!! amazing and entertaining lectures, he genuinely really cares about students and loves teaching. tests are very lecture-based, so while attendance isn't req. you should definitely still go to class + bc of the mandatory participation (which is not bad, hes nice even if ur wrong) i would def recommend!
This guy is the MAN. Best professor I've had at UT by far. Take him.

Prof. Q is a gem! Genuinely such an inspiring man with a clear passion for doing the right thing and helping people learn. Lectures are a lot of fun and very interesting - even some of the more dry subjects are enjoyable because of him. Tests are completely manageable, just study in advance, read the textbook, and you'll be good!

Professor Q is an amazing lecturer. His lectures were engaging, and he prioritized communicating important and useful concepts. Tests were lecture-heavy, so attend class and be attentive. Not too many assignments but good amount of quality writing needed.

I MADE AN ACCOUNT JUST TO RATE PROF Q 5/5!! I'm not even joking when I say this is the greatest teacher I have had in my time being in school. I will probably tell my kids just how good he was. His "lectures" are incredible the way he gives hypotheticals. And will literally spend class time telling us how much we matter to him. Hands-down the best!

Best professor ever. I enjoy his classes and often think about everything i learned in it. I wish every professor was like this. He sends encouraging messages and is just a wonderful example of a great person overall. TAKE IT! best business minor for sure!

Best business minor class hands down. Interesting content and clearly passionate about the subject. You learn a lot just by showing up and participating, don't even need to put in that much effort to retain information. Tests are super easy if you pay attention. Really fun class and really charismatic guy. He has a great personality

I LOVE PROFESSOR QUINTANILLA. HE'S THE BEST PROFESSOR AT UT AND SIMPLY DESERVES THE BEST IN THIS WORLD. He is truly so passionate about teaching and it shows. He is inspiring and respected. He loves his students and business law, the best professor ever.

This prof is AMAZING!!! He is such a wonderful lecturer and everyone comes to class even though you only need to talk a handful of times for your participation grade. I have never loved a class more. 10/10.

Lectures frequently go off topic and on random tangents which wouldn't necessarily be a problem but he likes to trick students who don't attend class regularly and add questions on exams from class unrelated to the course. He usually spends half of class time yelling at students for not paying attention and class often feels like a waste of time.

He is a terrific lecturer and teaches a very compelling class. I would give him 5/5, but was not given my participation points (10% of your grade). Said you only had to participate 3 times to get full credit; I participated 6 times and only got a 7/10. Take notes on the class and book for open note exams; it helps a lot to merge them w the slides.

Amazing professor and although I ended with a C (all on me I was lazy this semester until the final) as long as you go to class, read and participate, and look over the exam reviews you're golden. Prof Q uses real examples instead of just reading off slides and cares so much about his students. Highly recommend!

One of my favorite professors at UT. I learned so much in his class and truly enjoyed lectures and what we were learning about. Will call on you in class but usually the answer is on the board or if you don't know he's super chill about it. Gives cool uncle vibes.

This class is awesome and the prof really emphasizes attending class because he discusses test material which can't be found in the text. Also, participation is a big part of his class but he's not rude if you don't know the answer to his question. The exams are hard if you don't study. Read the book, go to class, take notes and you'll be fine.
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--Participation matters--Amazing lectures

reviews.comment: Professor Q has become one of my favorite professors at UT. His lectures are engaging! I learned alot. He is also such a nice, caring person. If you show up and listen, you will do great on the exams!

Prof. Q was the best professor I had at  UT, and I am a junior. He genuinely cares about each of his students and teaches topics that are important to our future. Attend class and be ready to talk. The lectures are truly interesting,  and it helps to go to do well on the exams. A few group projects but nothing major. Read and attend class.

I didn't do the best in this class ( to my standards) but I respect Professor Q a whole heck of a lot. He was a great professor when I had him and I learned a lot. It is evident in his teaching style that he truly cares about his students. For my business minors/ people going into law, if you have a chance to take him... highly recommend it.
Best professor I had at UT! Lectures are super engaging and exams are easy if you pay attention and take notes during class.

Professor Quintanilla's lectures were always so engaging and very easy to keep up with. Textbook was also an easy read and directly related to lectures. The assignments are easy, and exams (even our final) was online and all open note. Only thing I didn't like was the participation grade, but it's not too bad if you keep up with your readings.

Professor Q was very passionate about teaching and truly wants you to succeed. Lectures were actually fun to attend because he uses stories and example to explain concepts and he is genuinely a funny person. Participation is a good chunk of the grade so you will be expected to speak up occasionally but it makes the class a better experience.

This has been by far my favorite class. Prof. Q is an amazing lecturer and I really enjoyed going to class. It is very important to go to class and participate to get points. The exams are open notes and open textbook and are very easy to get an 80+ on. All and all if you go to class, take notes, and do the readings you should have no trouble.

I was at most of his lectures, and he gave me a pretty low participation grade, which was 10% of the grade, which screwed the whole thing up even though I did very well on the exams. He wants you to attend class and actively participate, like answering questions; if you don't want to participate in that degree, don't choose his class.

Prof Q. is very passionate about teaching, and that passion shows in his lectures. He made the online class engaging and explained complex topics in a practical manner. He rewards your participation - by answering questions and attending lectures, the assignments and exams are very doable. Enjoyed the class a lot; he taught very useful concepts!

Prof Quintanilla is the best lecturer I've ever had. He makes every complex law topic easy to understand. TAKE HIM IN PERSON!!!! and always go to class, it's not mandatory, but participation is part of your grade and really all you need to do well in this class is take good notes during lectures. One of the few classes I actually loved going to!
Hands down the best professor I've had at UT so far. He is the best lecturer I have ever had. I learned so much and wish I could take him for another class. Great person too.

Professor Q was the best professor I have ever had and probably will ever have at UT. His lectures are incredibly engaging and make the material really interesting. You read 2-4 chapters a week, but the textbook is really useful and relates directly to what he talks about that day in class. He is really kind and caring, genuinely a great guy.

My favorite class at UT thus far! He is so engaging and makes sure all of the material is practical to life. I looked forward to going to class. I highly recommend going in person to take this. He is incredible at what he does and you can tell he is passionate about the material. Tests can be tricky but he does his best to prepare you.

Professor Quintanilla was an awesome professor, very funny, and taught the course materials extremely well. While Business Law is never easy, his teaching style and eagerness to help made it easier. Just do the readings, do your assignments, study for the exams, and you'll be fine. No doubt one of my favorite professors during my time at UT.

Professor Q is hands down the best professor I've had. His lectures are engaging and funny. You can tell he's a really good guy. Attendance isn't mandatory, but participation matters for your final grade. But you'll want to go to class every day - it's one of the only classes I actually look forward to. Wish he taught more classes I could take.

He has lived up to the hype. Such a genuinely good guy, who is amazing at what he does. His tests are no joke, but he prepares you so well and tells you what you need to know for the tests during lectures. You must participate, but he makes it really easy and fun; after a few classes, you will want to talk as much as possible. 10/10 professor

Amazing professor and class. So much fun to learn in this course. Don't be fooled, though, it is not easy. You definitely need to study and know your stuff. Write down every example he says in class, they are on tests. The final project was graded pretty tough too. Geat professor who cares about your learning. Reach out to him and get to know him
Amazing lectures and amazing spirit. He is passionate. Take his class!!

Amazing professor! He was an entertaining lecturer and took the time to show that he cares about his students. Attendance isn't mandatory, but you should really go since some exam questions are about things discussed in class. The course itself was very easy. As long as you do the bare minimum (go to class and read the textbook) you can get an A.

TAKE THIS PROF! GO TO CLASS! Prof Q is so amazing. This class changed my life no joke. You MUST go to lecture to do well on tests (which can be somewhat tricky but not horrible). Homeworks & group proj are easy. Review sessions are incredibly beneficial. Prof Q is incredibly engaging, passionate, & caring. I looked forward to class every day.

Hands down the best professor at UT! He is so passionate about the material and his students. His lectures are extremely entertaining and you learn so much in his class just by attending the lectures. Grading is very test heavy which can be stressful, but if you read the book (very easy read) and attend lec it's not a difficult class at all.
reviews.rating_tags: Participation matters--Test heavy--Graded by few things

reviews.comment: Goated professor. Lectures were engaging and he went out of his way to make sure that students understood the content. Although reading can be a bit tedious at times, I found the information interesting. He rewards and encourages participation. You can tell he is passionate about the subject and wants students to succeed. Overall, a must take!

Prof. Q is an amazing lecturer. I enjoyed coming to class to listen to his anecdotes, and he really breaks down the topics into a consumable form. He cares about his students, offers great feedback, and tries to get everyone involved. For grading, the tests aren't too difficult because they are open note, just a bit nuanced. Overall 10/10!

The greatest professor I have ever had. Lectures are absolutely amazing and I would listen to them even if I was not in the class. The material is pretty interesting, and even when it isn't, he makes it super interesting. The actual class isn't that hard too, just a decent amount of fact memorization, but they're also open notes. Definitely take.

Loved this class and the material. It's just three tests and three assignments for your whole grade. He's an amazing professor and is so captivating when he lectures. One of the best professors I've ever had.

I am so sad that I can't take another class with Professor Q. He is definitely one of the BEST professors I have had at UT and is not the average, mean McCombs professor. He is super passionate about his work and getting to know his students. Participate in class! Go to class! You will really enjoy his lectures since he makes "boring" content fun.

Prof Q is a kind, passionate professor and wants his students to do well. The class was very fast-paced, but he posts lecture notes and keeps lectures engaging. Exams are online/open note, but you have to pay attention in class and take notes. Non-exam grades were easy As. I learned a lot in this class and I'm glad I got to take Prof Q while at UT.

Professor Q is a gem at UT. His lectures are very clear, and he engages well with the class even through zoom. He really cares about his students, and is somewhat flexible. Make sure to pay attention to his lectures, as he will tell you what is going to be in the midterms, as well as through his review sessions. Loved his lectures and stories!

I will tell anyone who listens to take this class and take it IN-PERSON. The professor is incredible, the exams are so fair (open note), little textbook reading but not bad at all. Im premed, Ive never considered law school but after this class I am. Truly one of a kind professor who cares so much about you, he wants to help and makes that clear.

One of my favorite professors. He's super caring and really wants everyone to succeed. He's funny too. His lectures are super interesting and actually make you want to go to class. Exams are easy as long as you pay attention in class.

Made me really interested in Business Law tbh. There is a textbook, but it's really easy to read! He makes you want to read it before each class, so you can participate in the discussion, although it's not completely required.

If you're wondering why my grade isn't posted, it's because I'm writing this halfway through the semester. Anyway, professor Q is by far one of the best lecturers on campus. He's passionate in this class particularly and will make you intrigued and want to come to class. You will get from him what you put in, so come to class having read the module
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--Participation matters--Amazing lectures

reviews.comment: Amazing professor. Lectures are engaging and easy to follow. He likes to include funny hypotheticals to help you understand the material better. In class participation is a decent part of your grade so make sure to speak up a lot if you want an A. Tests are open notes/book and not super hard if you pay attention to the lectures. Would recommend.

Professor Quintanilla makes this class the best of the entire business minor curriculum. You probably want to take this class online with another professor, don't do that. Take it in person with Professor Quintanilla instead. You will enjoy the lectures. Tests aren't bad if you read the questions carefully and pay attention in class.

I never write reviews but Professor Q was hands down the best professor I have ever had at UT! He makes me want to go to class to learn and he applies everything we learned from the textbook to real life applications to help you get a better understanding of the topic. My only thing is participation in class is part of your grade.. Take professor !

Mr. Q is great. His lectures are interactive and fun, and he seems like a great guy. He assigns reading every class, but I never did the reading, and he went over the important stuff in class. Tests were open note online, and we had a few other assignments that weren't difficult.

Mr.Q was an awesome professor! He was very respectable and kind and has truly found a way to make law and ethics interesting for everyone. It is also very evident he wants the best for his students. His class consists of 2 tests, a cumulative final, homework, and a group project. Tests are open note but usually average in the low 80s (study hard!!)

11/10 professor with amazing lectures that makes learning about business law fun. Class participation is highly recommended and is a graded factor but he makes it easy to participate! Group project, small assignments and exams are other components of the class. I literally recommend this class to people even if they just need an elective.

The best professor at UT!!! He is always available during office hours and super helpful on giving feedback. Part of your grade is participation but his class is super engaging and fun. You have to go to class in order to do well on tests, because he mentions a lot of examples. Best prof ever, couldnt recommend him enough.
reviews.rating_tags: Skip class? You won't pass.--Test heavy--Amazing lectures

reviews.comment: Take this class. Best professor I have ever had. Really sad I wont be able to take it again. He cares about each of his students and I would go to office hours just to learn more/talk to him. He helped me pursue my career in law and look into law schools. Hes awesome!!!
reviews.rating_tags: Participation matters--Skip class? You won't pass.--Amazing lectures

reviews.comment: Mr. Q is by far the best professor I have had, I am upset about the fact that this is the only undergrad class that he teaches because I want to take him every semester. Mr. Q wants a relationship with every student that will further them in their career, not just pass the class. His lectures are so entertaining. TAKE THIS CLASS!
reviews.rating_tags: Gives good feedback--Accessible outside class--Participation matters

reviews.comment: He's an amazing professor ! He makes law easy to understand, and gives interesting examples of real-life scenarios using the students' names lol. He does call on you randomly but there is no pressure to answer everything right. He genuinely wants students to do well and enjoy the class. His exams are very very lecture heavy !
Easily, the best professor at UT. He is very engaging and easy to pay attention to. Take this class, you won't regret it.

Mr. Q is an eloquent and charismatic speaker but he randomly calls on people in class and expects everyone to talk in class. He often goes off on tangents or creates scenarios that are not relevant to the test or context to the lecture. Despite going to every lecture and studying the book intently his test was difficult, office hours recommended.
reviews.rating_tags: Participation matters--Skip class? You won't pass.--Graded by few things

reviews.comment: I'm only one month in and he's the best professor I've had at UT Austin. He's a great speaker with charisma, and there are things we learn beyond the textbook. He is super articulate and smart but on top of that a great person.

Mr. Q is awesome. The class is super pragmatic--you'll learn more about real-world things than any other class. The chapters apparently have been condensed down and 10 pages at most. Go to his lectures because 75% of the exam is the stuff he'll say in class.
reviews.rating_tags: Participation matters--Skip class? You won't pass.--Amazing lectures

reviews.comment: Mr. Q is my absolute favorite teacher at UT. So passionate about teaching, truly loves his students, and wants to impact their lives. I learned so many interesting things in this class, though the tests could be tricky. You definitely need to show up to lecture, participate, and study a lot/go over lecture notes. Overall a great class!
reviews.rating_tags: Participation matters--Skip class? You won't pass.--Amazing lectures

reviews.comment: TAKE THIS MAN'S CLASS! Looking for a LEB for your Business minor? please take him. Messed up and turned in my CIS late and want everyone to see this review. He is an AMAZING professor. Yes there is reading but it's not a ton yes you have to study but no allnighters or anything close to that. He is funny, engaging, and truly does care about everyone

Mr. Q is one of the best profs I've had and this was one of my favorite classes. Lectures are engaging and fun. Tests were easy because it was open note, but you still need to go to class. Fun/quick group project at end of semester. Mr. Q acknowledges all opinions and really cares about his students. TAKE HIM FOR LEB 320F you won't regret it!
reviews.rating_tags: Skip class? You won't pass.--Inspirational--Amazing lectures

reviews.comment: I'm writing this as I am studying for his final so you know my final grade will not have a bias in this review. In my experience as a college student, I've had very few professors who have made such an impact on me through their teaching. Mr. Q is probably one of the most genuine professors you will have the privilege of having. Simply take him.

Mr Q is the best professor ever. He is genuinely a great person - cares about all of his students, is passionate about his course, and gives helpful advice. Mr Q is a highly respected person by all of his students! You are missing out if you do not take this class!

Best professor I have ever had across any school by far. This class was hard, but Professor Q made it so enjoyable. I actually looked forward to coming to class. No compliants. If you are on the fence about taking any of his classes I would say 100% absolutely do it. You will not regret it!

Professor Q has been nothing but amazing. He helped us get through these covid times without even feeling like we were taking it online. He engages with his students and he truly cares about his students. Take him if you can, I took him for my business minor but if there were other courses I could take with him I WOULD.

Mr. Q is hands-down is the kindest professor. He truly wants the best for all his students. Participation does matter and his tests are tricky, but they are open note and if you show up to class and pay attention very doable! I would take any class taught by him in a heartbeat.
A wonderful professor who truly cares about his students. Class can be difficult but the professor is very accessible.
reviews.rating_tags: Skip class? You won't pass.--Test heavy--Caring

reviews.comment: Professor Q. is one of my favorite professors at UT. I really enjoyed his class. His lectures are long and detailed, but he explains in a such a way that you won't forget them. The tests were mainly taken from the lectures & the book, so don't miss any lecture & make sure you take really good notes.

One of my favorite profs ever. Tests can be a little tricky, but if you pay attention in class and participate, you will be fine. Really loved him, he truly was such an amazing prof. Did a really great job at keeping us engaged even when in zoom as well

Dr. Q is literally one of the best professors I have ever had at UT. He cares so much about his students and all of his lectures are super engaging and fun. You have to take really good notes in class though because his tests are super tricky. Overall great guy and great class. Take him if you can!
reviews.rating_tags: Skip class? You won't pass.--Hilarious--Amazing lectures

reviews.comment: Graded on only a few assignments and tests. Great lectures, and a great guy. Gives great feedback. His tests are pretty tricky, though.
reviews.rating_tags: Gives good feedback--Respected--Skip class? You won't pass.

reviews.comment: So Professor Q is my favorite professor ever. I didn't do well on his exams, which is basically the grade for this class (super test and reading heavy), but he is super chill and funny and he cares. He knows everyone's name, stops class to make sure that we know our rights, and teaches some really interesting concepts in really amusing ways.

Mr. Q is easily one of my favorite professors at UT. You can tell he genuinely cares about the material of the course as well as his students, and makes sure that the class is engaging. If you pay attention in class and do the readings (which can be sometimes heavy), it's not hard to get an A. Great Class, even greater professor.

I LOVED this class! Mr. Q is really one of those teachers that brings the class to life. I took this class during COVID-19 and he always made sure everyone was okay. You will have to read a lot, but other than that the class is so engaging and interesting that it was without a doubt a highlight of my semester.

Professor Quintanilla is one of my favourite professors I've ever had. He really encourages student participation, which is really helpful to help understand the material. Tests are open note (no electronic notes, until online school) and open book. I took this class during COVID19 and he made it very easy to keep track of work and material.
reviews.rating_tags: Skip class? You won't pass.--Hilarious--Lecture heavy

reviews.comment: My favorite professor of all time. He inspired me to pursue public policy and he taught me so much in his class. His lectures are really fun to listen to and he fosters a great sense of participation among the students. TAKE THIS CLASS!! It's worth it. Reading in the textbook is very recommended but u might be able to get by without

MR.Q IS THE BEST! He genuinely cares about his students and makes an effort to get to know you. His lectures are extremely engaging and he gives amazing examples to better explain concepts. The tests can be tricky but if you read the textbook, listen in class, and ask questions, you'll go great. Honestly, this is the best class I've taken at UT!
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--Participation matters--Amazing lectures

reviews.comment: Prof Q is an extremely nice and caring professor that goes out of his way to make sure students understand the material. He will even speak with you over the phone if you cant come to office hours. However, his tests are difficult and his participation grading is relative to other classmates, meaning it penalizes the naturally quieter students.
reviews.rating_tags: Accessible outside class--Get ready to read--Participation matters

reviews.comment: The exams are very very very tricky. The lecture is really interesting but the exams are so hard.
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--Skip class? You won't pass.--Test heavy

reviews.comment: I took Prof Q during summer and wow he is such a great lecturer. We had 3 assignment (easy 100), participation, group project (2-3hrs), and 3 exams. Exams were not as hard if you read and listened during class. We talked about current issues and practical laws that we can utilize later in our lives. He was available most of the week. TAKE HIM!

As a senior, I can confidently say that Professor Q's class has been one of the best in my entire college career. He is always accessible, whether by appointment or phone call, and encourages each of his students to think for themselves. Although it was challenging, I cannot recommend this class enough. Take him if you can!

Love him as a person, but wasn't a fan of his class. You have to go to class and write down every little thing we discuss to get a good grade on the tests. Grading on all the assignments was unclear-there's no rubric and you are compared to other students, then given a grade.

Literally the greatest professor ever. His tests are a little tough, but they are curved. He is actually so caring and personable, I think he understands what students go through on a way greater level than other professors do. The lectures are so fun and engaging, and he is so knowledgeable. You have have have to take LEB with him.

Mr. Q is one of the best professors i've had at UT. Really passionate about teaching, lectures are super engaging and fun. I've learned a lot of practical knowledge as well. Tests are open note and open book. A few assignments which are not hard at all. Would highly recommend.
reviews.rating_tags: Skip class? You won't pass.--Amazing lectures--Caring

reviews.comment: Mr Q is honestly the most amazing professor I've EVER had at UT!! I could literally cry writing this review because of how much I LOVED THIS CLASS! (not kidding) Tests aren't too hard if you pay attention in class and you could probs get away with not doing the reading BUT if you do it before class and it makes the discussion so much better!
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--Participation matters--Amazing lectures

reviews.comment: Mr. Q is an engaging lecturer and a very sincere person who teaches you life lessons that will last beyond the course. We always discussed current events that helped contextualize the concepts we learned. Be prepared to read and speak during class.. tests are tricky but curved a ton. This class kept me "woke" and is one of my all-time faves! Love!!

I signed up to take Mr. Q because he was the only professor still available, but I am so grateful that that's how the cards fell. Mr. Q is a lovely person. He really wants you to think for yourself. Yes, this is a Business Law course, but he has a Master's is Philosophy and he really stresses the importance of being able to think for yourself. :)))
Quintanilla is an amazing prof!!! He has super clear lectures and is such a cool and laid back guy. He really cares about his students and wants you to succeed. I would take him again if I could!

Avoid taking this class if you can. The majority of lectures devolve into her chatting with a few students about her politics. Constantly tries to push her own agenda, and asks loaded questions on canvas. Doesn't seem to have a very strong background in computer science and most issues discussed are generic tech issues. Lenient on late submissions.
reviews.rating_tags: EXTRA CREDIT--So many papers--Accessible outside class

reviews.comment: The class is very easy but not particularly interesting. Take if you want a simple upper div CS class.
Just take her. She's very understanding of deadlines and flexible to your needs. Just go to her classes and you're fine.

I took HDF 306 with Professor Quimby. She was very accommodating during my time in this course when it came to online vs. in-person attendance and sick days. While the concepts were certainly important, they could have been explained in 1/5th of the time. Easy class -- prepare for two simple essays total, and weekly discussions posts. You got this!

Dr. Quimby is so so kind and understanding. Lectures are interesting and she is always ready to help her students. Workload is not heavy. I would take her over and over again. Wednesdays are office hours instead of class. Take Quimby for any HDF classes.

I have nothing bad to say about Dr.Quimby! Her lectures are extremely engaging and the assignments to be completed weekly hardly feel like work and only take 30 mins to 1 hr to complete. It's important to actively participate to make the most out of this class but Dr.Quimby will never make you feel silly for speaking your mind.

Took her for HDF340. While her lectures are politically charged, she encouraged open discussion and was very honest with her own experiences. She constantly stressed the importance of mental health days and rest. We had to do a discussion post, presentation, and occasional paper per week, very low effort class but the information was invaluable.
reviews.rating_tags: Participation matters--Amazing lectures --Graded by few things

reviews.comment: While the class was easy, we often talked about her political views rather than the course content. She was a very nice woman, but I didn't feel that class was the right place to be so politically charged.
Would recommend! She's really sweet and caring and is mostly concerned with professional development. She keeps it real to allow us to develop professional skills.

Dr. Quimby has been one of the best professors I've ever had at UT. She is GREAT, and she makes this class so interesting. There's a lot of discussion posts and activities but I did not mind it at all... She is very engaging with her students, and I really appreciate her education and open-mindedness about the issues in the world today.
Go to class. She is amazing. You won't regret taking her class. She's super sweet and funny!

As long as you keep up with the work, it's an easy A. If you miss a few tho, it's hard ot get back up on your feet. There was like 2-3 assignments a week and then tests every 4 weeks. Overall great experience for a summer class.
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--Participation matters--Lots of homework

reviews.comment: Took this course online over the summer and was extremely easy. Not much homework and very few quizzes which is all your grade is accumulated with.
The average of every assignment was failing or close and her feedback was terrible
Easiest government credit. You watch lecture videos from O'Brien. Exams are so straightforward. Never used the textbook.

Dr. Huang is a nice guy. You go through a lot of material and a bunch of math derivations in lecture. But, projects were not too hard w/ a bunch of extra credit. Exams were pretty hard but graded leniently. I think this was his first semester teaching generative visual computing, but it was pretty good.

Topics are very dense, both for good and bad. Concepts often feel somewhat overwhelming, but you will doubtlessly learn a great deal about a great deal. Exams are very rough, but graded leniently. Assignments are moderately rough, but have plenty of extra credit. Brush up on your math and be prepared for slow lectures.

Covers difficult concepts, some of which are not explained in depth. Exams are very challenging but graded leniently. Assignments are challenging, but you get 12 slip days, extra credit opportunities, and they're not graded too harshly either. Uses MATLAB which is not ideal, but u have the option for python for later assignments iirc.

Class was graded off of 6 projects and 2 exams (tons of EC tho). Exams were difficult (mostly theory that was covered in slides) but graded very leniently. Projects (choice of matlab or python) were time consuming but covered really cool topics. Lectures that didn't involve linear algebra were pretty good, but the ones that did were a struggle.

His lectures aren't the best, and he throws a bunch of formulas on the slides and expects us to understand them. Projects are interesting but difficult, but he does give lots of time to complete them. Exams are very difficult, but they are graded leniently. There is also lots of extra credit. It is easy to get an A, but lots of work is required.
reviews.rating_tags: EXTRA CREDIT--Lecture heavy--Graded by few things

reviews.comment: His lectures can be dry sometimes but if the class is interactive and asks questions he gives great responses and tries to explain things better. Exams are difficult and comprehensive but not graded tough, and assignments are very difficult as well but we are given ample time to do them and 12 Slip days to use throughout the semester. Decent prof

The grade distros lie. People drop the class, also there's extra credit/lenient. The workload isn't bad (2 weeks/project) 5 projects total. But he slaps formulas onto slides and doesn't explain them well. Lots of self research to understand the linear algebra/calculus. This class is good if u r interested in CV research and want to know what's new.

The lectures are great! Generally speaking computer vision is math heavy and requires lots of reading, but he managed to cover most of the important topics without much of background requirements. There were lots of extensions that were based on his own research, but those were never tested. Tons of extra credit, homework was manageable.

Very dry lecturer. Did not provide a syllabus and never gave out a clear grading scheme. Tons of generous extra credit (A total of 24 extra points towards our final grade). Thought a lot of complex topics were trivial and did not explain them correctly. Often brushed over topics necessary to complete assignments. Hard tests but graded generously.
reviews.rating_tags: Lots of homework--Get ready to read--EXTRA CREDIT

reviews.comment: The lectures are taught extremely slowly and are difficult to follow, I skipped most classes to study the slides which were generally more informative. He can be condescending at times, expecting the students to know information he hasn't taught. The projects are easy enough, but in Matlab and time consuming. Tests are also easy.

I stopped going to lecture after a couple of weeks because they were utterly painful. He gave completely false information about something in lecture and, after class, condescendingly argued that it was correct with absolutely no basis (though corrected himself the next day apparently). He touched on OpenGL for only a day. 100% regret taking him.
reviews.rating_tags: BEWARE OF POP QUIZZES--ACCESSIBLE OUTSIDE CLASS--GRADED BY FEW THINGS

reviews.comment: I loved this class! Fun and slightly more creative, but not difficult. Exactly what an elective should be. Professor Rossmann has a lot of cool experience, and it was fun hearing his stories. Easy and fun A. Highly recommend.

He is the nicest and most flexible teacher I've had at UT. He cares for his student so much and will use his many connections in the industry to help you succeed and broaden your network. If you show up to class, you're going to do very well in his class.

Professor Rossmann is an amazing professor. He truly cares about his students and tries to get to know every single one. He is a great talker and is so funny. If you can take his class you really should!

Really enjoyed this class. Prof. Rossman clearly cares a lot about his students and made an effort to get to know all of us. I found lectures somewhat boring, but the concept of building a brand throughout the semester was pretty cool.
I would definitely take him again 10/10 recommend if you're looking for credit/a chill upper division elective.

reviews.comment: DO NOT TAKE THIS CLASS WITH HIM!!! DON'T BE FOOLED!! If you miss 3+ classes say goodbye to the possibility of an A in this class. Also makes weird comments about female students which made me personally uncomfortable.
reviews.rating_tags: Participation matters--Group projects--Graded by few things

reviews.comment: Great professor! Super experienced in the advertising and marketing industry, which showed through his lectures. Definitely recommend!

I took the online version of this class and lectures were pretty boring. There is always one project and a group discussion due every week. The work is pretty easy but kinda just feels like busy work. The grading isn't strict either. He also provided a lot of extra credit opportunities.
His lectures are boring and he really can't teach material himself (video heavy). Projects are easy enough but group discussions are annoying, especially online
He is a very laid-back professor and very passionate about what he teaches. Class structure is easy with just one individual and one group assignment due weekly.

The professor is very relatable and warm. Each class seemed to be put together the night before (he lectures by reading PowerPoint slides). There is very little work to do (you can get an A by coming to class+1hour of homework a week). He is charismatic, but not experienced as a professor (most people like him, but feel bored to death in his class)

Very easy class. No exams or papers, just a couple of assignments every week. There are weekly group assignments but they're simple. My main complaint is that the assignments feel kind of disorganized at times and the lectures aren't super engaging. But the class isn't stressful and the professor seems nice and understanding.

He's an awesome professor with tons of incredible entertainment marketing experience. Definitely a useful class if you're developing a small business or your personal brand, as you work on it all semester. While the class lectures were pretty basic, Steve was an amazing professor to have, and grades very easily (easy 100).

Cool class, I'd highly recommend. You meet twice a week on zoom, but you don't even have to show up. You create your own brand at beginning of semester and do fun projects for it all semester like mood boards, advertising posters, commercials, a logo, etc. Easy grader because he just loves what he does and loves everyone's creativity. Nice guy.
filler class. If you want to take a break, use this class
very nice!

Super in depth lecturer. Classes technically didn't have attendance taken but all the work we did was in class based, practically no outside work necessary. As long as she sees that you are trying you will get a good grade if you put the work in. Highly recomend
reviews.rating_tags: Participation matters--Graded by few things--Online Savvy

reviews.comment: Extremely easy, one open-note benchmark quiz per class determines the majority of your grade. The course is interesting and engaging, but sleep is more interesting and engaging, so that's what I did during the lectures.
reviews.rating_tags: Clear grading criteria--Graded by few things

reviews.comment: Best teacher I think I had at UT Austin. Made me seriously consider statistics as a career path. Don't worry if you don't know anything before the class, Zarate is easy to talk to & she gives great advice. If you put some effort/interest in the course, you will get a good grade!

She was my course coordinator, and is very energetic in lectures as well as very accessible outside of class. A lot of times, her email reminders were the reason I was submitting assignments on time. I'm sure any course she teaches would be a great time.
Take this class!!!! it was so easy and if you are scared about coding, Dr. RAZ gives you step by step instructions to assure you will do well on the R assignments.

RAZ was the course coordinator for my psy 301 class in addition to managing her other class this semester, and she navigated it like a champ. Her beautiful graphs and witty comments made the class that much more enjoyable. I would highly recommend taking any course she teaches, as she is bound to make it engaging and relevant.
so funny and helpful pls take this class you will not regret jt

SHE SLAYS. MY THIRD TIME HAVING TO TAKE MATH AND SHE MADE IT SOME WHAT ENJOYABLE!!! For real, SIS TAKE HER, YOU WANT HER. If only I knew about her class as a freshman, not a senior. Take it online, super doable. Don't be afraid of the coding part, she has comprehensive walkthroughs that directly translate to the only FOUR assignments all semester.

Ms. RAZ is a wonderful professor who responds within minutes on GroupMe. The reason I put 3/5 difficulty is because I have never coded in my life, however, she assisted me through any issues I faced or any confusion that arose. I highly recommend taking her class if you want/have to take statistics!
reviews.rating_tags: EXTRA CREDIT--Gives good feedback--Accessible outside class

reviews.comment: RAZ was an amazing professor and I 100% recommend her for anyone needing a stats class or a QR flag. Was very understanding and caring, and was accessible outside of class and in the class GroupMe too. Amazing professor and an easy A!
Raz was very friendly and personable. The R assignments were the most challenging part of this class but were doable. Considering stats is difficult in general, it was an easy A.
reviews.rating_tags: EXTRA CREDIT--Clear grading criteria--Gives good feedback

reviews.comment: This is def the best stats class you could take. No tests, just weekly quizzes and bigger R/coding assignments once a month Raz is super helpful w them. def take this class for stats credit

Considering stats is hard, this class was an easy A. The main thing that sucks are the R assignments. Those take a long time but you have help. The quizzes are easy and no tests. Raz is funny and helpful and theres a groupme

I'm normally one to cry over my math homework and my math grades (COLA), but I genuinely enjoyed this class and I loved engaging with her. She's very straight to the point and gives us a lot of grades so your grade isn't hung up on one bad grade (she drops 1 low quiz grade

I took this class online, Professor RAZ had already made a groupme for us where she was super fast to respond to any questions. The most challenging part of this class was the R assignments, which is coding... they were not hard at all and the videos the professor posts are so helpful. She also offers extra credit, which was good. 130093/10 class.
reviews.rating_tags: EXTRA CREDIT--Clear grading criteria--Accessible outside class

reviews.comment: I took the Asynchronous version of this class, it was very organized and easy to follow. We used a software called "R" and had to do a very minimal amount of coding but it was a breeze; Professor Raz walked us through everything and was constantly answering our questions about homework in the GroupMe chat. I would 100% take this professor again!

Raz was the best professor!!! She is so entertaining, intelligent, and truly cares about what she's teaching. An open-note quiz each week, 4 R-studio assignments (she teaches how to do all work assigned)! It's easy to get help from Raz or other students. I recommend enjoying this class in-person. We all became friends over the semester!

RAZ is an amazing professor! Her teaching style and passion for statistics makes her class super engaging. Her R instructions are very clear and effective. She is an absolutely outstanding teacher, and I would recommend her to anyone looking for a great class!

I took this class in the async online format.  10 out of 10 would recommend taking this course.  She has expertly crafted this course, making it very easy for the student to excel if they put in the effort.  The video lectures are informative and entertaining, and she makes time to meet with students even outside of office hours.
reviews.rating_tags: EXTRA CREDIT--Clear grading criteria--Accessible outside class

reviews.comment: Prof. Raz was excellent and this math class was the best I have ever taken. I was a B math student all through high school but this course was so well put together and clear I received an A. She was always available by Groupme and email, and super helpful. She made math and statistics accessible for everyone and I learned a lot. Take this class!

RAZ is great; she's hilarious and helps with coding in the GroupMe. Her class is manageable and has 8 small assignments, 3 R "projects" and 9 short, async, open note quizzes. One of the best math classes I've taken!

Raz is vastly knowledgeable about stats and exudes passion for teaching it. I took this class online, but she was available to help me through office hours and messaging. Her charming personality will draw you to come to class-- and, if you put in the effort, she will help you understand the material when you feel like you just can't.

If you have the opportunity to take RAZ definitely do. She had an asynchronous class and an in-person class. I recommend taking her in person, she is hilarious. 9 online quizzes, 10 questions each & everything is from lectures. 3 R assignments (coding) which she walks you through. and mini assignments here and there. Superrrrr manageable. TAKE HER!
RAZ is awesome and down-to-earth. Probably the coolest video lectures I've ever seen. Quizzes are simple, and R Assignments, while tricky, can be checked by her before you submit.
Asynchronous class, very easy quizzes. Videos were prerecorded but very helpful. Just keep up with weekly assignments, only takes a bit of time each week. She's super helpful and nice.

I could go on and on about RAZ, but I'll keep it short for the sake of all you people considering to take her course :) Whether needing the QR flag or genuinely interested in stats, RAZ's course is exciting, relevant, and engaging. Not only does she have the coolest outfits, but she truly wants you to succeed. My favorite professor and class at UT!

I absolutely loved RAZ! If you need any statistics credit or a QR Flag 100% take her class. I was so intimidated by stats and coding, but she makes it all so easy and will literally help you with anything. She is the sweetest and funniest person who brings in real and interesting topics to statistics and coding. Easy A and a great person.

Class had 4 coding assignments and every module had a quiz and usually one short assignment. RAZ is a great lecturer and super willing to work with students and review. She also set up a groupme where she and other students actively answered questions about assignments. Would totally recommend this class !
Ms. RAZ is the best professor ever, if you have to take this course for any reason. take it! its super easy and you learn quite a lot
Highly agree with other reviews. RAZ is what makes this course so great. Content is extremely applicable and relevant, I am a more proficient critic and reader of data and research.

RAZ has easily become my favorite professor at UT. She has a genuine love for stats and it shows. Her excitement is extremely contagious. I also highly encourage you to put your camera on if the class is still online. Her office hours are extremely helpful if you need it but she's also just a nice person and is really talkative (in the good way ).

RAZ makes statistical literacy both interesting and easy to follow. Plus, she is very accessible outside of class thanks to GroupMe (but please dont abuse this perk). The class requires the use of a program called R, but RAZ will teach you how to use it, and she provides both tutorials and practice assignments!

RAZ was so amazing! The way she organized her class on Canvas was so helpful and made getting to things easy and quick. RAZ really cares about her students. She was extremely understanding not only about the pandemic but also the big snow storm. At the same time, I like that she makes a point to let you know you're an adult & to be responsible.

By far one of the best professors I've had at UT. There are weekly quizzes which are not hard because she explains really well & she drops the lowest one, no exams & one final group project .There are some other assignments but they are not hard at all and she offers extra credit which you should definitely take advantage of.I recommend this class!

RAZ is probably one of the coolest professors at UT. She genuinely cares about her students and tries to make a connection with them, even in online classes. Shes funny and her lectures are interesting. I took this class because it was a requirement but I would take it again

Ms. RAZ is the best! She is passionate about statistics, willing to help her students, and has a great sense of humor. Even though I was a part of the asynchronous course this, I was able to attend the live lectures. While there are weekly quizzes, there are no exams in this course. I highly recommend this course.

RAZ is a dream! She makes all her students feel so capable, even outside their comfort zones. She was super accessible (we included RAZ in our class GroupMe and she always responded to any and all questions really fast). I'm a social work major and I was still able to do really well because of RAZ. Highly recommend this class for non-STEM majors!

Ms. Raz has by far been one of my absolute favorite professors Ive ever had. I am horrible at math and Ive always struggled, but Ms. Raz was a blessing. She genuinely cares for her students and is always ready to help you. There isnt a lot of homework, but there is weekly quizzes. However, they were a breeze, because of how well she teaches.

RAZ is a really caring instructor and explains things really well. If you don't understand something in class, she has great videos where she explains everything again and you can watch at your own pace. She wants everyone to do well and cares more about you learning the material than to give you hard assignments. No tests, easy HW!

I was so scared of taking stats but she made it so easy to understand. She really tries to explain everything in very simple terms. There were no exams in this class only quizzes. She cares more that you understand the material rather than making it super hard to pass the class.
Great professor, she can be lenient but also strict. As long as you do your work, you should be fine. Professor Raz also cares for her students and wants them to pass with a high grade.

TAKE RAZ's class! She is one of the best profs I've had at UT! She really cares about her students and is hilarious! I was worried to take stats, but she made the class so much fun and engaged her students! She was always willing to help you when you struggled! Definitely would take the class again! Also, there is extra credit to help your grade :)
RAZ is a great educator and just an awesome human being. She really cares about her students. I took stats in high school and hated it, but her class was so much better and she even made it fun

she is an amazing teacher goes over everything you need to know in class, the reason why my grade was so low was because of attendance, so go to class. if you have to miss her PowerPoints are very detailed and easy to learn on your own she also posts ws and the keys for extra practice quiz grades count for a larger percentage than the actual exams

Raz is the best! I was nervous about taking a stats class but ended up with an A because shes such a great teacher. All of her lectures are very detailed and shes always available if theres something you do not understand. She has about 1000 resources for each chapter and I truly think its impossible to not do well in her class if you try.

I loved taking this class! Raz is a super caring professor who genuinely wants her students to succeed! I took it because a senior recommended it to me as the easiest possible math credit (which wasn't necessarily a good reason,) BUT! I had fun every day of class and always looked forward to it :) Also, I genuinely learned stuff! That's always good

If you put in the effort, you should get an A. She gives a good review over the material and will you give you examples of the types of questions she asks on the test. The quizzes are online and easy (open note). Just take notes, do the homework, and do the review. There is extra credit, do it!
Definitely take this class. Raz is caring and funny and if you have a question about literally anything she will answer

THE BEST PROFESSOR BY FAR! She's so funny and super helpful. A lot of grades so test don't really affect your grade in a drastic way and she gives out a good amount of extra credit! I totally recommend her and this stats class!

I'm not usually good at math, and I was a little nervous about this class. I had NO reason to be! These were the most engaging lectures I've attended thus far at UT, and RAZ is a really interesting person. A ton of extra credit is given for those that choose to take it, and I never stressed about this class.

Zarate is really great. She is extremely engaging and takes things really slow. She also offers a really great extra credit opportunity that could raise your grade 2 letters and it's super simple. Overall, she made stats a fun class to go to and always gave us opportunities to receive candy. I would love to have her again as a teacher.

RAZ is such a great teacher, she cares about her students and always asks for feedback on her teaching or if she could clarify something better. I would recommend and also the QR flag is helpful as well. No homework outside of class only a weekly quiz online.

I was really nervous coming into a stats class, since I have never done super well in them. But RAZ was suuuuch a helpful and passionate professor. She really mad it possible to understand stats. I took an intro level class with her, so I'm not an expert, but I feel like if I wanted to keep going I could totally do it after her class.

RAZ is an amazing instructor that truly cares about providing an inspirational learning environment! I had no prior stats knowledge, so I was super nervous about the course, but her powerpoints, worksheets, & lectures were great. The weekly quizzes helped prepare me for tests and she was super helpful during office hours. Extra credit helped too!
i dont even know what to expect yet. but anything is better than Morgan Fong.

The programming assignments get increasingly hard through the semseter. There are many TA's but they have not been particulary active in helping students who have trouble with sessions being timed out in Gradescope. All assignments are graded with the auto-grader and no partial credit is given if you mess up the output of the code.

This class is not designed to be beginner friendly. It gets increasingly difficult fast and there are many assignments due each week as homework, some right after test days. The coding assignments are difficult with the autograder which is super finickly and often gives 0's for timed out sessions. Be prepared to suffer. A lot of AI is involved.
by far the worst teacher I have had. save your time and your GPA don't take this class. she's nice, but she has no clue on how to teach, just save take any other professor

Dr. Ravishankar cares a LOT about her students. She's a very good person. Her lectures can be confusing, but watching the pre-lecture videos and going over the solutions to the problem sets are more than enough to learn the content. The exams aren't too hard. The weekly quizzes can be very unforgiving with grading, but you do get 2 quiz drops.

Nice teacher who cares, doesn't lecture the best. Hard to fail since homework, zybooks, and final project all free 100s. Exam questions also come mostly from review guide, although there's only 2 questions per exam.

The professor is nice and all, but she just doesn't know how to teach a class. She assumes everyone already knows and understands the content, and glosses over things. The tests were easy though, but there aren't any practice tests or additional content. They just told us to just reuse old problem sets.

Dr. Ravishankar is a pretty good teacher. Lecture explanations can sometimes be a bit confusing, but if you actually watch the pre-class videos (which are required for attendance points), it's really easy to connect the dots with any weirdly explained things. The quizzes are super easy and homework is as hard as the tests.

This teacher makes people's lives harder. Content is not hard but she explains it in the most abysmal way possible. Can't understand why UT choose for her to teach a very important theory class like this!

Her lectures are so confusing and unclear. The TAs are the only reason I learned anything. She gives you practically no tools to prepare for the exams. However, the exams and quizzes are pretty straightforward, but the lectures are a straight-up waste of time, even though you still have to go because attendance is graded.

Wow her tests were so easy, and she's actually like one of the nicest people ever. She is excited about the topics she talks about, but she isn't the best lecturer, and you sort of ending up learning the whole class with the TAs. Take her over Parikh if possible!

This class is poorly organized, it is very easy to get overwhelmed and confused by the homework and assignments especially at the beginning of the semester. Prof is nice and TAs were very helpful but she is just not a good lecturer, and there are in-class assignments during lectures. Self-study and try to go to TA sessions.

This was one of the best classes I have taken this semester. She is an amazing professor and all the bad reviews are just people mad at their grades. You just need to focus in the class.

Before you enroll, inform god that you will be sitting with the devil twice a week.

Lowkey just be ready to do the textbook problems, class isn't done completely yet so like if I do bad in the final it's on me lowkey and I deserve a bad grade. Take her over Parikh, easier tests. Genuinely not even bad, she's super sweet and will try to help you. Her lectures are trash to be honest, but like the concept is so easy you don't need it

Other reviews are low-key exaggerating. Lectures are pretty boring and I have to pregame with a monster to pay attention for the full 75 minutes. She isn't as bad as everyone else is saying. For the first unit, its ok because you can learn by yourself. Then, the next two units get ready to suffer.

Prof writes in cursive, assumes you know a lot of things (ironic since this class is about not making false assumptions). Then to top it off, gives insane quiz every week, where a small mistake in the start will cause a 1/10 or 2/10.

Professor Ravishankar made my life horrible by forcing me to learn everything by my self for hours at home because she cannot teach. She also makes attendance mandatory, and the lectures are a complete waste of time.

eh... yeeee. don't take

You can tell she wants us to do well in the class, unfortunately she isn't always the easiest to follow. Do not listen to any positive reviews of this professor. I am stressing that no matter how much extra credit or curves she offers, every class is infuriating.

take another professor.

yall are tweakin shes not THAT bad. is she the most organised? no. but ed discussion is so helpful.  also the tests aren't too bad, they're challenging but fair. in fact, the code is the easy part but boy does she give weird short ques. exams are 45% of your grade tho so can't slack off and also there are barely any quiz drops. no attendance tho

Genuinely a terrible prof. She makes mistakes in her own work, isn't clear on programs, and lacks the ability to answer questions clearly. Truly so terrible I made an account to write this. do not take this professor. its a beginner course but she makes the exams and assignments incredibly difficult. her lectures are difficult and complicated to follow. her TAs are also harsh graders. this is literally the first time I've had to write a review for a professor. TAKE ANYONE ELSE.

Weekly quizzes are based on one hw problem from the additional set, and make sure to use the ASME test bank to study for tests, as problems are often recycled.

It's Thermo; it will be difficult. However, Rodriguez is caring and communicative enough to lighten the mental load. We used an online textbook (ZyBooks) with participation (watch a few animations) and challenge (homework problems) activities built in. Study for weekly quizzes, cram for tests, and rest assured Rodriguez is there to help out.
Dr. Rodriguez had the most organized Canvas page I have ever seen, and he makes expectations very clear. Super kind and approachable- would highly recommend for 318M

Nice professor, and it is helpful that he is an editor for the textbook being taught. Weekly assignments are super easy, and the lab quizzes can be challenging. Dr. Rodriguez is a phenomenal professor! Was always there to help out if you needed, lectures are straightforward and helpful, first exam and final were online. Textbook is $90 and all "homeworks" are through it, but this class was a de-stresser

really nice guy and an amazing professor! it is super easy to get a good grade in this class while also learning the course material. we had weekly quizzes but they were really easy to study for and the weekly homework was super quick and easy (and actually helped me learn). he also brings snacks to class (coffee, cookies, candy, etc.) LOVE HIM!!

I would highly recommend! As long as you do the readings and homework, Dr. Rodriguez does his best to keep his students on track and cares very strongly for his students. I would take this class again. Challenging, but the prof made it worth it.

Brooke W

Dr. Rivaux is extremely caring and is always there to help. BEWARE STATS is hard. Like pretty hard but you can always ask her questions. She will go over the material several times. she was generally good at explaining concepts but would sometimes get a little flustered if students were consistently having trouble understanding. Dr. Ryfe is awesome!! If you love journalism you will love him. The news assignments for the first five weeks were annoying but everything else is pretty straight forward, it is super helpful if you take good notes during the lecture.

just no. she doesn't seem to care about her students success and so rude in person. in terms of the class itself, very interesting but all she does is read through the slides and doesn't add anything to it. if you ask her a question, she either doesn't know the answer to it or expects you to answer it on your own. Professor was okay. Since the online class was just watching prerecorded lectures, there is not much I can say about her personally. You can work ahead in this class which is a good thing, but the order of the canvas material was out of order so when I worked ahead, the info required for the quiz was not under that week which messed me up.

The professor is passive-aggressive and will be sweet at first but throughout the course, you can tell that she only cares about the grades students received on exams. I've studied for days and hours for her exams but I still barely pass. JUST DON'T TAKE HER CLASS SAVE YOUR GPA

I expected the worst. In reality, I found myself in the easiest class on my schedule. There are weekly quizzes due at 11:59 pm on Fridays, a four-part deep dive assignment, and three case studies. Everything was manageable. I did some parts early too, so there were weeks when I didn't even have to look at the course. The textbook was not needed.

The class average for the unit exams were extremely low and she refused to curve them. She was very unclear on what we needed to study. Many people ended up dropping the class. Her lectures were not engaging and she was not polite to students who asked questions or showed frustration about her unfair grading system.

Was looking forward to this class but finding it so hard to enjoy. Units are CRAMMED with material in order to get through the entire textbook; textbook readings are extremely lengthy and are accompanied by additional materials (40 minute podcasts, extra articles, etc.). Dr V. is very passionate but i wish she remembered we have other classes too

Completed several assignments over the semester that dealt with professional development. One lecture a week and 3 absences allowed. Some video assignments with discussion comments. Make resume and linkedin. Lectures are not very interesting but have some tips and guests speakers sometimes. Read the clifton strengths book and completed the test.

Disorganized. Materials were hard to find & were posted way later. Assignments are locked until right before the due date, & all assignments due at 1 pm. Lecture slides were never posted after. There is three case studies, four "deep dive" assignments (topic, source, summary, presentation), 10% attendance grade (instapoll), and many quizzes (50%)

took psy339 asynchronous with Dr. Villanueva, class is graded by watching the lectures, doing weekly quizzes, and working on a research assignment thruout the semester. quizzes could be tricky but there was also a lot of EC offered for the quiz grades. would rec if you are good with keeping up with deadlines on your own time!

The prof is too loud, her review slides barely help, and the tests were challenging. I didn't get the textbook but most people got bad scores on the first test even if they did the readings (she preps u horribly). It feels pointless, but only two absences are allowed. She's not engaging and I know this is subjective but the vibes just aren't good.

Felt like this class barely scratched the surface of any specific diagnoses or treatment or clinical theories and prof read off the slides various DSM diagnostics and then had people discuss personal anecdotes. Generally felt that the course had an air of insensitivity toward psychological disability and lacked nuance. Easy grade but annoying.

This class is easy but the professor is so boring. Her class requires attendance but her lectures are boring and pointless because she reads off of the powerpoint. Exams are easy, just review the powerpoint and the review materials given by the TA. Never read the textbook and I was fine. Boring but easy class, so I'd take again.

Fall 2023 was Dr. V's first semester here. She did an astounding job, despite that. Homework every week that is due Sunday night, and 3 exams-- nothing too hard.  Can be challenging, but everything you need to know is in her lectures, so pay attention! So passionate about teaching and really cares for her students. Would recommend!!!

I love Dr. V!!! Fall 2023 was her first semester teaching at UT Austin and she did an AMAZING job. I had Dr. V for HDF 315L and HE 102P. She's super passionate in both classes, and you can tell she loves teaching. She cares a lot for students and is extremely easy to talk to. One of the best profs, would def want her as a prof again!

Dr. V is amazing! I had a smaller class with this professor, making the experience even better. Homeworks and txtbook readings were very reasonable. The workload in this course is VERY manageable. Exams can be challenging, but nothing crazy! Dr. V is so sweet, I've never had such a proactive, involved prof before. I would absolutely take her again

He's an incredible person! Lectures are always engaging. He does teach in a very implementation-based format, and you have to work through the nuances of what he teaches. Assignments are fairly long. Grind out past exams, and make sure to do well on them, because it's nearly 90% of your grade, and it will make or break your grade.
reviews.rating_tags: Test heavy--Graded by few things--Accessible outside class

reviews.comment: Discuss the professor's professional abilities including teaching style and ability to convey the material clearly

Lectures are pretty engaging but most of the content will be through doing the past exams. You can do well in the class just by doing and understanding all of the past tests. People complain about the assignments and the hygiene but if you attend all/most of the classes then you only need an average of 15/20 on the assignments.

Mike cares so much for his students it's insane. He loves teaching and it shows -- just go to his office hours. I was blown away by his patience with me every time I was  insanely confused with something on an assignment or content (which was, well, a lot). Don't cheat, and lock in early on those practice exams -- exams reward those who do.

He has great assignments that inspired me to program other adjacent areas, but he has too many points on his "hygiene guide". Large amounts of test preparation are provided, and office hours help. Lectures can get tangential and favors obnoxious, loud students.

Mike Scott has already become one of my favorite professors at UT. His teaching style is amazing and after completing this course, you really feel like you can do anything. Just make sure to do assignments well even though they're only 10% of the grade and go to class as the exams really test your knowledge on these things.
I mean, he's the only choice you really have, the class is definitely hard but he teaches it well.

Mike is a great lecturer and a great guy. I feel like I learned sm more about computer science in this course than ever before. It is really hard though, and you have to spend a lot of time on programming assignments and exam studying. lowk got cooked by the final. The TAs are so helpful and pls go talk to mike at his office hours. He is the best.

Lectures are really engaging and keep you awake. The homework can be difficult at times, but I found it really helps to get a better understanding of the class and to do well on the tests. So, as long as you put in some effort into listening to lectures, doing your homework, and doing some practice tests before exams, you will be fine.

Very nice professor, accessible outside of class and happy to answer questions. Tests being worth 87% is brutal for someone who has test anxiety like me, just wish the programming assignments were worth more. 25 hours of work for 1% of your grade. Overall great guy tho!

Mike Scott is the GOAT of entertaining lectures. But I would say to make sure you take time on your own to fully learn the material.

Prior knowledge of data structures is extremely helpful for this class. There is so much material to learn in such a small amount of time.

To succeed, GRIND past exams. Dedicate ~2 weeks before exams.

This class is a rough one. This teacher is good, he's a cool guy, but the grading structure is just not super forgiving so as much as learning from him is great having to prepare for the exams alongside it is challenging. Final i took is hard and hoping for curve, learned a ton though, just didn't transfer a lot to the exam unfortunately :(
Its Mike Scott. I don't need to say anything else. Legit the best professor I will every have and best professor at UTCS. 10/10 Would take again

When Mike retires, UTCS ranking falls out of top 10. Definitely NOT a blow off class, but it does a very good job of shaping washed, vibecoding, took-APCSA-two-years ago students into being ready for a real CS education. Do practice exams, get used to being tortured by the code hygiene guide, start on prog assignments early, and enjoy the lectures

Many students find these lectures to be entertaining. And that is very true, I had a fun time. However, that stops once you walk out and realize you didn't actually learn the material past a surface level understanding and are forced to teach yourself everything in this course. If you want to succeed just finish assignments and grind past exams -_-
Your mileage may vary

do the practice exams. trace the solutions for the programming problems if you have to. learn the concepts you miss for the short problems. if any problems have a pattern learn it. watch or attend every lecture. 
Mike is a very good and even kind professor but he is rigid with his class outside of extranous circumstances.

Engaging and enthusiastic lecturer. Coding assignments can take a lot of time (start early!). Tests make or break your grade. Tests are difficult but there are a lot of practice and sample tests to ensure you do well (I recommend studying for these at least 2 weeks before).

Best CS professor I've had, lectures were very engaging. HW's are a lot of work but doable, don't affect grade too much but are very helpful for understanding concepts. Midterms are bulk of class so study A LOT (DO THE PRACTICE EXAMS). Difficult, but doable and fun class. Scott's teaching single handedly convinced me to not drop out.

One of the most goated professors in the department. Chill and approachable guy with amazing lectures. Tests and projects were graded rather harshly, but is overall a great class that pushes you to learn.

Goated professor with amazing lectures. Three exams weighted 90% of your grade, but plenty of review material and exam content is fair. Projects are doable and help to solidify understanding of material covered in class. Overall one of the best CS profs I've had at UT.
90% of your grade being from tests is outrageous
Overrated professor
I will miss him!

Mike is an amazing professor. The lectures are very entertaining, and the assignments are super helpful for preparing for the programming sections of exams. There are plenty of practice tests available so there is no excuse to do bad. I simply got horribly sick during the final and bombed it, but if you put effort you'll do great.

Going to lectures is definitely helpful (there's always like one/two things you can only know from going to class). Not that difficult, assignments are only 10% total, so don't stress about them. Goated prof ngl

Amazing professor, super funny guy to be around with great lectures, class is difficult but isn't too bad overall. Tests are 90% weight and can be a lot, so study for those (there are 20+ years of past exams on his site). Assignments are difficult, but doable if you use help hours to your advantage (start early!)

Mike Scott is wonderful and is one of the best, UTCS professors. His lectures are amazing, and he incorporates many funny anecdotes. It seems he has every lecture thought out perfectly, and he brings enthusiastic energy to each one. The tests are fairly difficult and 90 percent of the grade, but he gives abundant past tests to help you prep.

Mike Scott is a fantastic professor, a real gem within the UTCS department. His lectures are super engaging and interesting, where it seems to be a conversation rather than a lecture. 
His class is super test heavy (90% are tests) but he has many past tests released that are the exact same format, use those. The labs take a long time, but are worth

Best UTCS professor, hands down. His lectures are really nice, especially for people with no prior knowledge. His assignments are a bit time-consuming, but you can get them done, and doing them yourself is a great way to develop skills for the exams. He releases all his previous exams, so there's a lot of practice material. Overall, amazing class.

Tough class if you don't have much experience but the format/past exams help a lot in securing a good grade.

Make sure you actually do the assignments as tests try and question whether you GPT'd or actually did the work

Loved his lectures. Really nice and engaging guy. If you're already familiar with data structures, you shouldn't find this class too difficult, though some projects may be time-consuming. If you're unfamiliar with them, there will be a lot to learn, though it's still manageable. He releases past tests, so they're a great resource for studying.

Very engaging lecturer that teaches you a lot of useful topics for future classes. Content was very interesting and weekly labs weren't too bad. Exams were a little challenging but felt like high school tests in the way they mostly challenged your memorization.

Mike is a fantastic lecturer. His class is undoubtedly challenging with difficult projects and heavily-weighted tests, but he provides you with more than enough resources to succeed. Start projects early---that way, the TA's are more accessible and willing to help.

He is by far my funniest professor and an amazing lecturer. The exams are weighted a bit heavily (90% of the final grade), but the enormous amount of test materials provided make up for it. You will miss this class, especially when you're in comp arch.
Best prof in UTCS. Plenty of material to review for exams. Assignments are clear and simple with the help of TAs. Absolutely loved taking this class.

Mike is an experienced lecturer who makes the material engaging. The assignments can be challenging but manageable with TAs' help. Prep well for exams, and Unstuck ai can be a handy study tool alongside other resources like ChatGPT. Overall, a solid class if you put in the work.

Contrary to his reviews, Mike's teaching style was a little all over the place for me, making it hard to take notes and understand material. Programming assignments are hard but doable with TA help. Exams are hard so prep in advance by doing given practice. Overall not a bad class, just unorganized for my tastes.

Probably would have gotten a higher grade in the class (A) had I studied more. Most of the lectures I attended were absolutely tremendous and Mike and the TA's did a phenomenal job at ensuring we all had a fundamental understanding of Data Structures. Do not worry about your grade. Worry about the concepts instead and the grades will come!

I think the reason this class is so great is because Mikes been teaching it for 20 years. It just seems so well thought out, well structured, and its clear what is expected.
