reviews.comment: he's so knowledgeable and nice!
reviews.rating_tags: Accessible outside class--Group projects--Clear grading criteria

reviews.comment: Bill is such a wholesome guy. Does his best to interact w all his students.
Mini projects take up lots of time, but was okay. Prof Wolesensky is always very helpful.

Bill is the BEST professor I have ever taken. He genuinely cares for his students and made the transition to online VERY fair. He will stay after class to help you and he responds to his emails/piazza very fast. There are homeworks and group projects that may take a long time, but he will help! Lots of opportunities for extra credit. TAKE HIM!!!
What a guy 10/10
Lots of work outside of class, but bill will help if you email/go to office hours.
Do well on ur mini projects. If you make it v nice and organized, hell give you extra pts!
Gr8 guy*
Gr8 guy
he did his best to remember every student's name and was a very cool professor. 10/10
Hard topics for those who don't really know math, but awesome prof

Bill is incredibly caring and a great prof. He breaks down more complex ideas and topics into simpler terms and shows you exactly why math shortcuts work. He wants you to do well and the workload is more than fair. There is a lot of homework, but you have more than enough time if you don't procrastinate. It's an easy A, but you have to try.
p cool guy
GREAT! Office hours are definitely helpful if you don't understand the material. It's usually pretty crowded tho.

Dr. Bill is one of the most sincerest professors I've had at UT. He truly cares about the success of his students and will do his best to give you everything you need to be successful. Homeworks aren't hard and the group projects were okay.

He doesn't like teaching the material but likes to see how students try to find an answer. All learning is done outside of class even though it is a 5 hour course. All assignments other than the tests can be done with a group. Homework assignment due every two weeks but it is very difficult and time consuming.
reviews.rating_tags: Lots of homework--Graded by few things--Group projects

reviews.comment: I LOVE HIM! He truly cares about his students & gives good feedback. He teaches you not only math concepts but how to implement them into real life situations you'd use. Lectures were not mandatory but highly recommended. Discussion sections were mandatory though. You have to work for your grade just like any other class but it was not too much.

Bill was a really great professor, the class was manageable, however it does require a lot of outside learning. It also requires group projects which aren't bad if you get a good group as the assignments do need to be approached from every perspective. Discussion days were felt very pointless and the TA was not much help at all but was very bubbly.

Bill is seriously the best professor I've had at UT. Math has never been my strong suit, but he makes it very easy to understand. His lectures are very relaxed and he's excellent at explaining the material. The homework assignments are extensive and a lot to keep up with, but his office hours are very helpful! Definitely take this class!
Absolute lad.

Best professor ever. I regret not getting to know him. He cares so much about his students and wants everyone to do well. A lot of different assignments but it doesn't really matter because grading is so lenient (he drops a lot). If you took calc in high school you will be more than prepared. He also talks about his old beef jerky business a lot.

Bill is by far my favorite professor at UT. It is obvious how much he cares about his students, as well as how passionate he is about his work. Lectures are engaging as he works to make the curriculum applicable and relatable (something in which I thought was impossible for a subject such as calculus).

I mean there is a reason he has the best rating at UT!!!! TRUST ME when I say that Bill is the GOAT, consider it a privilege if you have him. He actually cares about everyone in the class and will help you succeed. Dw if you are not good at maths/calc he makes the content extremely understandable. So yeah, take him for business calc!

By far the greatest professor at the university. His passion for teaching and math is so obvious and hes so inspirational. He does everything to make sure students genuinely understand the topic and will do anything to help every student pass.

He is a very caring professor and knows how to teach calculus in a way that is easy to understand. I had him as a professor for two semesters and loved it. His work isn't intense if a problem is hard he is always available at office hours or right after class.
reviews.rating_tags: Gives good feedback--Accessible outside class--Clear grading criteria

reviews.comment: I wish every single math teacher I had was like Bill. The man is kind, understanding, a good teacher, and truly cares. He is probably one of the greatest professors to walk this Earth. Thank you Bill, not only made me enjoy math, but you made me enjoy life. And, I mean that sincerely :)

Bill is an angel of a human. Consider yourself lucky if you are able to have him. Even in a big class, he will learn your name and just want to learn about you as a person. He has so much genuine love for his students, and loves to tell you how smart you are. Best confidence boost of my day. Lots of homework but you won't even care bc he's Bill

Bill is hands down the best professor I have had for UT. Take him for business calc!! He really cares about his students and was very understanding the whole semester especially due to the hardships of corona. Bill made me appreciate calculus more and use it in real life. You will not regret taking his class.

Best professor I've EVER had. Let me tell you -- I hate math. Detest it. So I was super scared to take this class because I've heard terrible things about UT calculus. But Bill helped me ENJOY math. Go to his office hours! It's like hanging out with a good friend. He is so nice, chill, funny, inspirational, and has a heart of gold. I <3 Bill!!!
Hands down the best professor on campus by miles!! He cares so much about your character and easily will help if you ask! Plus he is 6'9 ft so that's also a plus lol

Literally the best professor on campus by far! I hate math with a passion but he made it so much easier to understand and learn it the way it is supposed to be taught not just so u can get the right answer but to actually understand deeply what are you doing.

Best professor at UT. I took 408R with him and that was the best decicion I made all year. If you have the chance to take his course you better do it. Hes such a nice professor and he genuinely cares for all his students. Best part of my semester hands down. Also his class is a really really easy A if that's all you care about.

Best professor ever. Bill really cares about his students and wants them to get more out of his class than just math knowledge. Go to office hours so he gets to know you and it makes it more fun, also it is just helpful for the projects. The homeworks are long but they are helpful. Tests are not bad if you have a grasp on the (cool) concepts.

Bill is the best prof I have ever had at UT so far. He is kind, caring, personable, and understanding-I wish all of UT profs were just as great as Bill. I took M408N and M308S with him and excelled in both of the classes with no prior calculus background. His class exemplifies that if you put in the work and stay focused, nothing is impossible!

Professor Wolesensky is the only professor that I've ever had who truly cares about his students. He tried to get to know each student and he genuinely cared about our success and wellbeing. The class is difficult if you did not come in with calculus background but he makes it manageable! He loves math and he is so brilliant it blew me away!

All I have to say about this man is good things. Ive never been very good at math and Ive never understood it better than when taught by Bill. He is kind, patient and more caring than any professor Ive ever had. There is a heavy homework load, but Bill is always accessible and makes ample accommodations. Absolutely worth every minute I spent!

This is the best professor I have ever had. This man is amazing and truly cares about his students. The class is not difficult at all, even if you have never had calculus you will probably make an A. He truly deserves 5 stars and if you can you should take his class. You will not regret it.

Bill is the highlight of my day everyday. It is sad that I do not have more time in his class. He re-motivates me in lecture not only in math but in everyday life and for my other classes as well. If you are lucky enough to get him as a professor, do NOT hesitate.

If you ever have a chance to take 408R with Bill, don't hesitate, take the class. Bill is the kindest, nicest, happiest, and smartest professor I have EVER met. he is so approachable, funny, and just so kind that I cant even explain. The class is easy, but the homeworks can be lengthy. But never fear! Bill ALWAYS goes above and beyond to help.

I took 408R and he made it so interesting and worth your time. Lectures and expectations are clear. Tests are easy if you go to class, discussion, and do the homework that can be lengthy. 408R is an easy way to get calc credit if youre a bio major. Plus, Dr. Wolesensky is the sweetest and an amazing professor!

Bill is easily one of the best professors at UT. He takes great pride in his teaching and makes it his own goal to have all of his students understand the material no matter the difficulty, and even remember students' names! The material covered can get tricky, and I advise to visit him during his office hours, he always wants to help his students!
reviews.rating_tags: Lots of homework--Accessible outside class--Amazing lectures

reviews.comment: Bill, as he likes to be called, is so dope. There is a reason why he has a 5.0. I'm serious. He is such a great guy and goes to his office hours. Also, he cares about your success and he is the best calculus professor at UT. Fair class. 5 days a week but he makes calculus bearable and easy to understand. TA was chill. Work on hw early. Best prof.

Many of the other professors at UT did not give a toss about whether or not we UNDERSTOOD something. And if we didn't, they would berate us and say, "You should know this by now". This is not Bill (he goes by Bill). His exams are significantly easier than any other professor that I've had because he checks for understanding, not just quest.

Bill is seriously one of the nicest men I've ever met. If you're a Bio major and took a form of AP calc, the class is an easy A. Even if you haven't taken calc before, it just isn't very in depth and it so worth a 4 hour credit. I barely studied for the class and made A's on every test.

This is exactly how classrooms should be. This environment allows students to ask questions, raise concerns, practice and make mistakes without fearing the outcomes. He assigns a lot of homework, but it is all very low stakes and really helps drill the material. Bill was born to teach. He is such an incredible person.

Bill is a saint. Hes the most amazing person when it comes to explaining mathematical concepts, and when you dont understand something, hell do whatever it takes to help you. He is the least intimidating 6 8 man youll ever encounter, and is easily the highest quality professor at UT. He cares about his students, both as students and friends.

Bill teaches calculus like it's your first time exposed to the subject. He is very patient and ready to answer any questions you might have. There are group projects, homework, and the exams. The homework isn't too difficult, and he does some of the problems together in class.
TAKING LAB DIFFERENTIAL & INTEGRAL CALCULUS FOR BIOLOGISTS RIGHT NOW! COOL GUY!

Absolute best professor at UT! I had never taken calculus before this class and I passed with a high A because of his amazing teaching skills and clear lecturing. He was always easy to reach either threw email or office hours as well if any student ever had a question. Loved this class even though it was 5 days a week with discussion. Take Bill!

Though I completely dreaded the idea of taking calculus, Bill made the class manageable and enjoyable through his teaching. Make the effort and an A is obtainable. Extremely sad not to have him teaching me next semester!

Most caring teacher I've encountered. Lectures are definitely optional but I went just because he's a pleasant dude. He sometimes assigns a lot of homework but its pretty reasonable and straightforward. The graded worksheets in discussion can be tough on a time constraint but they are doable if you understand everything.

Dr. Bill is the KINDEST, most FAIR professor. If you took Calculus in high school this class will not be hard, but he does challenge you to think about things conceptually and not just simply memorize formulas. Genuinely cares and wants to make sure every single student understands the material. Best professor for a first semester student!

Bill is the best professor at UT. He cares about every student he teaches. He is very understanding and compassionate for his students. He grades very fair, and always gives good feedback on your grades. The class material is very difficult but he will help you if you're stuck. Go to his office hours. But, they get crowded- so get there early.

Bill is one of the best professors I have had so far. He genuinely cares about his students and loves it when you ask questions. He is such a positive person and makes learning about calculus less painful. DEFINITELY take his class if you are able to.

Bill is one of the best teachers I've ever had in my scholastic career. He is extremely caring about his students and makes sure the concepts he's teaching are being understood clearly to all of his students. He loves when people ask him questions! I'm so lucky to have him for my first semester here, and I'm trying to take him again for spring!

Great teacher, really helpful. Class is tough but very worth it. 12/10 recommend for anyone. It's math so of course its hard, but great teacher, great learning environment, could not speak more highly of Bill or his class.
I love this guy. Take him. Period.

The best professor I've ever had at UT. He made Number Theory very interesting. His lectures were great, and he thoroughly answered any questions that were had. He encourages questions and wants every student to succeed. I don't know what else you could want from a professor.

Bill is honestly one of the best options possible to take for any math course. He is one of the kindest and actually cares if his students succeed. Of course, if you don't put in the work then that's on you, but he'll do everything in his power to help. Take advantage of office hours. Take him if you can.

Bill is an amazing person, and care about his students!!! Go to his office hours!!! I had class during his office hours, and I truly believe I would have done better if I went to his office hours. The textbook is a VERY tough read, so get as much help as you can. Most of his quizzes and tests were fair, except his final was incredibly hard.
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--GRADED BY FEW THINGS--Amazing lectures

reviews.comment: Bill is the best professor I have ever had! Differential Equations is not an easy class, but Bill made it so much more fun and accessible than any other professor could have. You will NEED a study group for 427J, and Bill encourages it. Overall, great person and great professor! Get me a man that treats me like Bill treats his students.

He is an actual angel. This review is a few semesters late, but I had to come back and let y'all know how great he is. Go to office hours because he's the sweetest thing and loves getting to know and help his students. If you don't need help, go anyway, he's such a joy.
Bill is the perfect professor. Diff Eq. is a stressful class but he's got your back.

Material is difficult. All Calc is standardized so he really has no control over the material. Bill however, is by far the best professor because not only is he inspirational but an AMAZING teacher. Take him.

Bill is by far the best professor at UT and the best I have ever had. He makes a really difficult class much more enjoyable and easy to understand. If you can take him for any reason, you should. He is just an awesome professor and and an awesome guy. His exams are mixed of easy and very difficult, so although he is great, the class is still hard.

Bill is honestly one of the best professors I have ever had. He cares about every student and makes an attempt to know everyones name. He answers every question respectfully and clearly. Also incredibly fun to just talk to. If you want to learn calculus or gardening, talk to Bill.
Nicest professor ever! Also does a good job explaining math to students who are not engineering majors.

The best professor at UT. 10/10. His main goal is to see you succeed in his class and will help you every step of the way. There is no reason why you can't make an A in his class. He puts in 100% to make sure you understand the material. A dad. A true man. The world doesn't deserve Bill. If you have the opportunity to take him, do it.

Bill, how he prefers to be addressed, is an amazing professor. He clearly cares about his students and is willing to help you no matter what. The class material was pretty light and tests were pretty easy.

Took him for M302 and loved it! I was iffy about this course because I'm horrible at math, but it was ridiculously easy. Bill does a great job of explaining things and the course load is pretty light. 10/10 recommend.

This class is probably one of the more easier calculus classes at UT, but you definitely have to work for your grade. I wish I had taken more advantage of his office hours because he is the sweetest professor ever and truly wants to help his students. His lectures can sometimes be tough to follow but he does explain things well if you ask for help.

Great professor that is focused on his teaching. I would be cautious because he expects people to know about Cal before even taking it. Without my high school experience, I would've struggled severely. Curved grading near the end.

Bill was one of the kindest professors and people I have ever met. His class is very easy if you pay attention and do the work like he instructs and assigns. He truly cares about his students doing well, and works to make sure students understand the concepts comfortably. Best Calc. professor at UT!

Bill is the best and most caring professors I have had. He truly wants everyone to understand calculus and is always willing to explain concepts that people are struggling with. His tests never have any surprise questions, instead theyre usually questions similar to those that appeared in the homework a lot. He truly wants his students to do well.
Best professor ever.

Great professor who is incredibly understanding and loves to teach. His tests are generally only a couple of questions, so if you know the material you can finish quick. Math modules every other class, only about 4 questions. He made math interesting for the first time.

Bill is such an amazing professor! He explains everything so well and cares about his students. I completely failed calculus in high school but this class ended up being my highest grade my first semester. His tests are very easy and he drops so many low grades that its honestly super hard to not get an A.

Honestly, if you are a bio major looking for an easy calculus class Bill is your guy. Just take M408R with him, and you will be set. The textbook is free and is online. Discussions are mandatory, lecture not so much but who wouldn't want to be at his lecture. A lot of homework. Exams are easy if you know your stuff. He drops a couple of grades.
reviews.rating_tags: Gives good feedback--GROUP PROJECTS--Would take again

reviews.comment: Bill is by far my FAVORITE professor I've had! Not only is he an extremely sweet, dad-like man(yes he makes dad jokes and wears the dad outfit),but he TRULY cares about his students. He had like 200 students and he knew all our names. I've always been terrible at calculus, but Bill made it understandable and doable. Do your homework&you'll be fine!

I love Bill so much! His Hw is usually a lot of work but he tells you at least a week in advance and you also have the syllabus to remind you. He's a super chill teacher and always cracking jokes. Please go to his office hours and I promise you'll become besties with him and the class will become much more easier to get an A in.

Bill is one of the few professors that gives partial credit on tests and is open to questions. However, unless you have previous calculus knowledge this class is challenging. The class is a flipped teaching style where you do previous course work before class to learn the material and come to class ready to ask questions.

Bill is the BEST professor I had this semester. He's a genuine guy with nice stories and a good sense of humor. He cares about each of his students and I suggest going to his office hours to get to know him. I already took AP calculus so almost everything was review. Grades fairly and generous with partial credit. Enjoyed this class so much

Bill is the best math teacher I have ever had. He genuinely care about all of his students, and even makes an earnest effort to learn names. I took calculus in high school, so the class was easy, but his teaching style helped me to understand all of the math I had just memorized. If you are a natural science major, take this class.

Bill is the best. Such a great person and makes you want to go to class. Didn't take calc in highschool and was not nearly as bad as I thought it would be. Most kids that took AP calc are breezing through
Bill genuinely cares about the subject he is teaching and puts a lot of effort into his class. If you took calculus in high school, this class will be a breeze.

If you are a bio major in need of a calculus credit, I highly recommend taking 408R with Bill. Everyone in my class adores him. He is incredibly caring and patient and willing to slow things down to help you understand. He really cares about his students and wants them to succeed. There are times when the course is difficult but it is worth it.

Bill is the best professor at UT! He is like a dad and the sweetest man ever. He is a great teacher and always does what's best for his students. He makes calculus enjoyable and easy to learn. His TA Sam is not good but Bill makes it worth having a bad TA. He has pushed back due dates multiple times because he knew we were stressing over it.

Calculus is a scary class to take, but this professor made me love it. He is supper helpful and kind. He makes sure everyone of his students understands the material before moving on. I really enjoyed his class and would 100% take it again.

This professor is amazing! The class is really easy if you pay attention and actually work on each homework. By doing all the homework you study for the test. He is extremely nice and was willing to write me a recommendation letter on a different semester that I took his class on.

Bill is the best professor I had this semester and I would take his class over and over just for him. He truly cares about his students and never treats us like we're stupid. I already took calculus in high school so his class is super easy. The tests are similar to the problems we do for homework and worksheets. Tons of things are dropped. Easy A.

He is an amazing professor. He's the only one that I've had at UT so far that genuinely and fully cares about his students. He really makes it clear that he's more interested in making sure you understand the material rather than trying to just cram a bunch of different topics. His pace is great and yet you still cover so much material.

Bill honestly cares about his students and tries so hard to help you succeed. Class was extremely easy if you just show up and lectures are enjoyable and easy to follow. As someone who hates math classes, I would take this again because of Bill. Amazing professor. I can't recommend him enough.

Best teacher I have ever had. I go into his office hours every week for homework help and he's great. He genuinely cares about his students and we actually learn useful things. He's great at explaining things, and totally fine with tons of questions. He has taught us tricks to gambling and  tells us stories about his dogs. 11/10 would take again.
Best teacher ever. Honestly so nice and extremely helpful. This was one of the easiest classes i've ever taken at UT but was also totally enjoyable. 10/10 would recommend
reviews.rating_tags: Respected--Participation matters--Skip class? You won't pass.

reviews.comment: Had him for Intro to Math, one of my favorite teachers! Homework due once a week, but super easy to get good grades on and helped my average in the class. He will email out surveys about twice the semester and will give you extra credit for taking them. Go to class if you can because he will discuss exam questions.
reviews.rating_tags: Skip class? You won't pass.--Caring--EXTRA CREDIT

reviews.comment: Wolesensky is the MAN. He clearly cares about his students. He offers extra credit sometimes, is available through email and office hours, and he makes an effort to learn everyone by name. There's weekly homework though, so make sure you attend class to at least keep up. Overall though, he's a great guy and I always recommend him.
He was a great professor, very knowledgeable and fun. Helped me see math in a new light.

It's pretty easy to tell based on all of these other reviews, but Bill is definitely one of the best professors at UT. The only people that didn't do well in the class are the people that didn't show up, because Bill will answer any questions you have on the homework during lecture time. Take advantage of this, he is so wonderful!
reviews.rating_tags: Skip class? You won't pass.--Caring--EXTRA CREDIT

reviews.comment: Such a great professor! Not a super difficult math class, and he makes it so fun. Attendance isn't mandatory, but I don't recommend skipping because you'll be very lost. There are homework assignments due every Friday, but you have all week to do them and he goes over lots of questions in class. Really nice/funny guy who cares about his students.
reviews.rating_tags: Gives good feedback--Skip class? You won't pass.--Hilarious

reviews.comment: Bill is hilarious and so nice! Go to class though. Skipping will get you very lost. He is a super lenient grader though. At the end of my class he made an A a 91 when its usually a 93.

I took Bill for his Intro to Math class, it was really easy. He takes his syllabus seriously so make sure you read it. IF you don't show up to class don't ask what you missed because he won't tell you. He's a really cool guy.

He's very straightforward and considerate of his students, remembers the names of those who show up to office hours or ask questions in class. Course material was easy to understand even if you miss class. He walks through homework problems during lecture, though, and I benefited just by going to class and listening to his lecture. An awesome prof!
Great class and not so challenging. If you miss a class session the textbook should help out. Great professor and fun class.

Literally the best professor I've ever had. He is genuine, caring, and really wants your success. ALWAYS makes time for students, NEVER makes you feel dumb or inadequate for not understanding something. One of the best guys I know. I wish he were my father.
Great professor. Really cares more about you understanding concepts and learning to think critically, rather than whether or not you can remember formulas.
reviews.rating_tags: Gives good feedback--Respected--Skip class? You won't pass.

reviews.comment: Go to class and do all of the homework as well as the weekly quiz. If you work for the A, you will get it.
reviews.rating_tags: Gives good feedback--Respected--Skip class? You won't pass.

reviews.comment: Best math professor I've ever taken. Really understands how hard math can be and is very approachable. Grades partial credit very fairly on tests and also has weekly quizzes during discussion to help your grade. I could not recommend him more. You have pre-class modules and homework after every lecture though, so stay on top of it.

One of my favorite professors at UT. He truly wants you to do well and is very open for feedback/questions in and out of class. Homework isn't mandatory but you NEED to do it to do well. Best math teacher here and after some rough past experiences he helped me fall back in love with math.

Honestly, he's probably the best professor I've had at the University of Texas. He really cares about his students, and if you have any problems he'll work with you. He's open about his policies, and respects you. His class is hard, yes, but that's because it's a hard subject in general. If you read the book and the homework, you'll do well.

Bill is a great teacher. He was always very clear, clearly likes to teach, and makes sure that there are no random things on quizzes or tests that could surprise you. With that said, he is a tough grader and does not make tests very easy. He also basically refuses to give curves. I loved the class though and I would take it again with him.

Bill was honestly the best teacher I've ever had. He was instantly a professor that showed that he cared about the subject and his students. Be ready for a lot of learning modules and homework, but doing them is definitely worth it. If you do them and show up for the discussion sections, you'll definitely be ready for an test that he gives.

Although attendance isn't mandatory, go to class. He explains the topics well, often starting briefly with theory  leading into examples. Pay attention in class, it'll save you time. DO THE HOMEWORK. It takes a good amount of time - do it anyways. If you understand the homework assigned, expect to do well in the class. He's a great person/professor
Bill was an outstanding professor! Definitely take his class, you wont regret it. Hes an amazing lecturer and cares about his students. He should teach lecturers how to lecture. 10/10
Bill is absolutely fantastic. This was not an easy course, but he made it enjoyable. He is always in his office helping his students. The best professor I have ever had! I truly loved his class.

His students call him Bill because he is more like a really cool dad than a teacher. I had trouble with precal in the beginning of the course so he loaned me his own precalculus prep book. He made a super hard subject easy to understand. Calculus wont be a breeze no matter who you have but he will make it way easier and make you excited for math.

Bill is the man. Makes an effort to learn everyone's name. He holds the best office hours - helps you on anything and everything as long as you also go to class and TA sessions. Super nice guy. Gives two midterms and a final. Structured where 4/6 easy, 1/6 semi-difficult, 1/6 difficult. Lots of HW, but if you can do it all, you'll do well on exams!
He's so great. He explains things in a different, more understandable way than the book. He's always super available and interested in helping students. He really loves and cares about what he does.

Bill is by far the best math professor I've ever had! He is amazing at explaining concepts and wants every student to succeed. He loves feedback and class participation, so he notices who doesn't come to class (it's not mandatory but extremely helpful). I would take him for any math course because he is clear and just a kind person in general.
This is the best math professor I've had at UT. He is extremely good at explaining new concepts to students. He is also a very nice guy and makes a great effort to help anyone who needs it.

Took him during the summer session. He was by far one of the best professors i've ever had at UT. He tries his best to make everything clear and he really cares about his students.  Its easy to get an A in his class if you do all the Homework and attend lectures.  I would definitely take him again if he is teaching another class.

Awesome professor, absolutely the best one I have taken so far. Take notes and study them, he goes over what he feels is important and uses them on exams. Do your homework, it will be in your best interest. LISTEN, he gives you hints so you will do well. Bill answers any and all questions and is very nice to his students. Sign up while you can!!!!!

Best professor I've had at UT and I've been here for awhile. I don't even like math, but thinking about taking another math class with Wolesensky. Exams have proofs, but he explains concepts so well that they aren't too bad. Retaking this after Gilbert's M340L, which was easier, but bc Wolesensky teaches so well this class seems easier

Bill is so genuinely kind and cares about his students so much. He was always happy to answer questions in class and explain things more thoroughly. M 340L in general can be hard to wrap your mind around, and honestly most of the material covered seems really pointless. But nonetheless Bill was amazing and I highly recommend him for M 340L.

Bill is the man. He is really clear about the material and gives out printed notes with the important stuff. Great class to take as a first upper-division math class. Homework is due once a week and can be long (preps you to be a math major). Primarily proofs. Will try to take him again for number theory. Study for the test and you do well.

Best professor I have ever had. Takes time to learn the student's names, even in a class of 100. He is kind, funny, and the most sincere person you will meet. He is encouraging and is willing to help as much as needed. Expect a Quest homework following each class, and a Quest learning module prior to each lecture. He also assigns written homework!

Dr. Wolesensky is a great professor. He really works hard to make sure you understand the material and will often stay after lectures for 15-20 minutes to answer any questions that you have. Office hours are crazy because everybody goes but he usually does a good job of getting to everybody. If you have to take Calculus at UT take his class.

Professor Wolesensky was by far my favorite professor of the year. The flipped classroom with the learning modules and confusing quests were challenging but Professor Wolesensky really wants students to learn.  He takes the time to know us personally and really makes an effort to help guide students through this rigorous course.

Honestly, if you're gonna take M408K, which is a VERY hard class, you should try to have Professor Wolesensky. Bill is probably one of the best lecturersprofs for 408K and truly does wants his students to do better but Quest makes grading extremely tough and out of his control. Just spend ALOT of time reviewing material beforeafter class,not cram
A gifted teacher. Exellent professor, Crystal clear teaching. If i ever get the chance to sign up for his classes which i require i will for SURE.

Best math professor ever! I had never taken Calc. before and really struggled with it at the beginning. He's a very helpful professor who takes time to get to know his students, explain things clearly, and cover the material. Go to office hours, it's very crowded, but extremely helpful!
Best math teacher on campus for sure. The way he teaches is really smooth. Will help you so you can succeed for sure, office hours are really helpful. Nice guys, funny. AMAZING TEACHER.

One of the nicest teachers at UT. He wants his students to succeed. However, his tests are all multiple choice and are very difficult. It is hit or miss with his tests. Unfortunately, I missed. Study hard for exams and ask him questions. He will never deny helping you

The best professor I've had so far at UT. He's very kind and is genuinely interested in seeing all of his students succeed in the class. He is willing to go beyond what regular professors would do to help his students succeed. If you get the chance to take ANY math course from him in the future, be sure to do it! You won't regret it.

He is an awesome Calc professor. I was doing well in the class because of him. Sadly, quest makes the tests and the 2nd one was almost impossible to do, forcing me to drop the class. He is really helpful during office hours and works any problem you need help with. If you have to take calc at UT, TAKE HIM. He is extremely helpful and intelligent.

One of the best & genuinely kind professors I've had. Very open to questions during class and sincerely tells you students asking him ?'s or correcting him doesn't offend him at all. He made his own handouts that were 1-2 pgs summarizing textbook sections in easy-to-understand language for M325. Tests straightforward, easy if you did the homework.

As a somewhat inexperienced coder, this class definitely made me work for my A, but it wasn't impossible. If you do a bunch of practice problems, go to the TA and LA's office hours, and really understand the concepts, you'll be fine on the midterms. He was a really nice and funny guy who cared about us achieving long-term success.

He genuinely cares about the class. If you attend every class and follow along in lab, you'll be fine. It's harder than Lima but still manageable. Since it's all Python and the course was shortened, it's easy to follow—though Yeh spends much of the second half on stuff that doesn't really matter.

on the first day of class, he said he only wanted 50% of people getting an A- or higher. This was reflected in the 65 and 79 averages on midterms, but luckily I got 76 and 89 on them. By far the hardest i've ever worked in a course (to get the A). Tim really cares about each student and the TAs/LAs are super nice, caring and helpful with lab work.

Tim is a wonderful professor who truly cares about his students. He doesn't care about giving them a free A, he cares that they actually learn the content in the class and know how to apply it. The labs were very well designed to facilitate learning among students and the lectures included example code which could be adapted for the final project.

Tim is a really good guy and very funny. He cares about his students a lot, but his lectures were often completely irrelevant. Labs are helpful and graded by TAs

BEWARE his midterms are impossible. The average was failing and they are graded super tough. They also count for a big chunk of your grade. I would avoid taking him for this reason alone
