Has very good lectures as well as clear recording of them. The class is very straightforward and systematic in its structure. He himself is a funny guy and caring for his students and while there are a lot of assignments, each assignment is worth less by itself and he drops or curves grades for everyone.

Cepparo is a great guy, is respecting and cares about students. Easy to communicate with. His lectures are 50/50 for me since some of them I understood but others I wish his teaching could've been better.  His quest homework was extremely helpful and exactly like the test. Spent about 3-5 hours per week on work.

Amazing lecuters. Quest and written homework due each week, but the written hw is SUPER HARD. Exams are also super hard but are based off of quest. Gave lots of extra credit though and genuinely cared about his students. He took the time to learn each of our names even if we had never spoken to him at all.
Quest was easy, textbook homework was hard. His exams reflect quest, not textbook hw. His lectures are well done. Great personality.

He was worth taking before he changed his syllabus. The amount of homework he assigns being only 28% of your grade compared to the 50% it used to be is egregious, his lectures are unorganized and he doesn't really teach the material that will be on the test, M408D is hard. He does his best to make it easy, one of the better math professors.

One of the best math professors I have had! Lots of homework (around 30 problems weekly), but grades leniently on the written portion (office hours help). Test are half take home and half in person (helps with average). Attendance is mandatory, but his lectures are very engaging!

He's the best professor I've had at UT so far. Dr. Cepparo makes calculus interesting; yes, the class comes with a lot of HW(2 per week) but the exams are easy if you practice the quest homework. I would recommend everyone to take Gustavo, this class makes you learn a lot without being crazy hard.

Professor Cepparo is so fun and caring, and a phenomenal lecturer! he made an 8am calculus class far less tedious than it could have been with his fun stories and jokes. 4 exams + a final, but each test is split between an at home portion and the in class portion, so the grade averages out better (since multiple choice is a KILLER). overall 10/10

I love Dr. Cepparo! For an 8am, he has amazing lectures with his great personality and enthusiasm for mathematics. Grades consists of written HW, quest HW, exams, plus attendance. Overall written HW were the hardest but office hours help, plus he explains things well! He has a his own personal variation of sounds he makes and it's so entertaining!
reviews.rating_tags: Amazing lectures --Clear grading criteria--Lots of homework

reviews.comment: HW heavy: my most time-intensive class. Written HW is crazy hard but quest HW is miles easier (and midterms are modified quest HW). It's an 8 am but he's super engaging and has a great personality so it's not too bad. I suggest reading the textbook and going to office hours because it was hard for me to learn only from lectures.
Gustavo is a very good professor.  Written homework every week (8 to 10 hard problems).  Quest every week (15 to 20 problems).  Exams have two parts.  His office hours and Calc-Lab are very helpful.

(There's a word count sorry) The elephant in the room: Yes this is an 8 AM. This was bad because my major had a lot of projects that led to me staying up late. That being said, Cepparo brought his passion and humor to the 8 am classes, making them worth attending. HW is long. Quest was easy. Exams were way easier than HW and mostly number problems.

He is very enthusiastic about stats and very kind. We had 9 homeworks(they use R) and many due dates were pushed back. Exams 1 and 2 were also pushed back. 40% of each exam was take home. Most of the exam material was in lecture and textbook but some was only in lecture. Very lenient grader. Hard to not make an A if you show up and do all work. :)
One of the best professor I have ever had, made an 8am lecture . As long as you keep up with the homework you will do fine in the class.

I found him to be an average professor. I personally felt he gives too much hw, especially since I am a CS major. Many times, the stuff he taught in class are MUCH easier examples of the hw, which doesn't really help. He does give a lot of extra credit though to boost your grade, such as dropping the lowest midterm. He was pretty funny though.
reviews.rating_tags: EXTRA CREDIT--Clear grading criteria--Lots of homework

reviews.comment: Professor Cepparo gives very straightforward, entertaining lectures. He moves quickly, but other campus resources like CalcLab and office hours help. Each week, there's free response textbook homework and about 20 multiple choice questions. Highly recommend this professor, great at teaching calculus and his office hours were so good
reviews.rating_tags: Amazing lectures --Lots of homework--Accessible outside class

reviews.comment: There is a decent amount of homework, but it is good practice to get good at the math :D! Even though his lectures were at 8 am, they were still fun and enjoyable. He was definitely a character! Tests were on the easy side when compared to practice tests. He also had extra credit points at the end of the sem. Highly recommend this class! LUOL >:D!

Cepparo was able to keep his 8 am classes engaged while teaching calculus. His lectures are informative and straightforward. He is humourous and easy to talk to. Most of the difficulty came with Homework. There is a lot of homework, but it is 40% of your grade. Exams are pretty easy and straightforward. A lot of partial credit. Emails are slow.

Gustavo was a very jocular man, who did an exceptional job teaching material. This semester he went back to in-person tests and mandatory attendance; however, if you have taken BC, it is simply just an in-depth review of that, plus some multi-variable Calc - which he gives a good overview of. Now that his class is over, it is TOTAL SADNESS :(

Amazing prof. Made it worth getting up at 8 AM MWF. HW is definitely tough (coming from someone who took BC in HS). Weekly Quest (Online) and Textbook questions. Textbook Qs could be pretty bad. Tests weren't difficult (not nearly as difficult as the HW) and 4 points were added to every test grade. Great at explaining concepts as well.
Goated Prof. He's funny without even trying. Keeps you engaged. Lots of hw that's usually harder than the test and the hw counts towards 40 percent of your grade.

Amazing professor that cares about his teachers and what he teaches. His energy and enthusiasm made the 8AM class a lot easier to attend. If you are able to do the homework and quest with a basic to decent understanding, the tests should be very doable and straight forward.

Overall a great teacher and a great class. Pura Vida! Total Freedom!

This class was doable only because I had previous calculus experience from Calc BC. People who did not take Calc BC found this class difficult because his lectures consist of only proofs and hardly any example problems so the lectures aren't helpful. If you want to do well you need to do a lot more examples from the textbook than are assigned.
"Oh Oh Oh okay wit dat" Super fun prof, made 8 am class much easier to attend. Lots of pretty hard HW but tests are not too bad. Good choice for M408D.

great professor, i'm not a morning person so the 8am was hard but lectures were usually really engaging and helpful, tests are graded with a lot of partial credit, hw is annoying and harder than it needs to be but graded leniently also

Total excitement every time I go to his class. His lectures completely make no sense to me, but I go just to hear his passion. There's a lot of self-learning in his class - I learned everything through the weekly homeworks. Exams were slightly difficult but he grades very very leniently. Definitely will take him again for his other stat classes.

Professor Cepparo was absolutely *perfect* for a first year calculus course. Yes, it will seem a little because it's different than your high school teachers, but trust me, Gustavo is on your side. He loves you all and will curve to oblivion. Partial Credit is given... just do the homeworks/quests and the tests will be 10x easier. INGUSTAVOWETRUST!

Sure, there's a lot of homework, but if you're able to understand most of the solutions to the problems then you'll prosper (get into a small study group of 2-3!). Cepparo himself has an awesome and quirky personality, and he'll always do your best to answer your questions. His lectures are engaging, and his tests aren't extraordinarily difficult.

initially took this class cause of the high rating, but beware of all the homework. this 8 am class killed me. could not focus in class and the homework due on saturday and friday was annoying. all the reviews was during covid time, so now there are in person tests (2 at a time). would not recommend

He was very clear with expectations and lenient when it came to assignments and exams. Lectures are a little difficult to fully grasp sometimes without the proper background in mathematics. I have had him for several classes (M349R, M339G and M378K). Gustavo has passion for math, statistics and data science. Overall great professor.

Absolutely amazing professor! Great lectures! Some people complained about the course, but those people also didn't participate. If you don't do the homework and actually follow the class you will have a hard time. Only take the course if you actually want to learn the stuff - then he will be the best professor you will ever have!!

Easy to get a good grade in this class. He offered a recorded zoom call throughout the whole semester so no need to show up in person, but he's a positive guy so class is enjoyable. He is a bit disorganized so he assigned less homework than stated on the syllabus. Exams are take home and closed note with a large time window to complete.

Really amazing professor! I never really went to class tbh (idk if i recommend that, def struggled w HW lol) but it was still a manageable course. There was definitely a lot of HW (both textbook and quest), but it prepares you well for the exams. Exams were open-note and open for 48 hours which was super nice - exams had both FRQ and MC

Pofessor Cepparo was a great lecturer. The class was very empty and quiet since it was an 8 am with no mandatory attendance but he still made it fun. Explains very well and also talks about his life which is nice. He makes funny jokes, sometimes completely off-topic, but his lectures are as enjoyable as any math lecture will be. Highly recommend.

Cepparo is funny, engaging, and really cares about what he teaches. He records his lectures and does not require attendance, making the course very manageable to your own schedule. There was a lot of homework due every week, but it helped for the exams.

Cepparo's class is very informative and hands-on with R.  We went over concepts and predictive algorithms in detail.  The assignments, tests and projects are a mix of applied and theory problems.  Every assignment uses some R.  He is very funny and gets very happy in teaching mode.  I reviewed some Zoom lectures to add details  to my notes.

Incredibly kind & funny guy, but I felt like his lectures were extremely hit or miss - sometimes informative, but a lot of the time he'd just mention things without explaining, but reading the textbook was a good way to supplement. Pretty easy grade-wise, but if you wanna learn everything be prepared to put in a little extra effort

One of the best professors (probability the best calculus professor). Although attended his lecture early at 8am, I really enjoyed his lectures. Very sweet and funny. Grading was pretty straight forward. Definitely will choose him again for the same class despite the class time.

Tests were all online and all very easy. LOTS of homework but it's basically all you ever need to do in preparation for the exam. If you want an easy A, take Cepparo. However, his explanations, while decent, can sometimes be unclear. He uses confusing metaphors that have nothing to do with math, and he makes many mistakes while teaching.

He's hilarious, cordial, and talks about his personal life. He encourages class participation and that people actually understand the material. The class itself? Hard. Quest at first felt like guessing game with some integrals. Written HW is lengthy, but you adapt and it becomes minor after a few weeks. 2 exams, one final, so they're worth a lot.

Cepparo was one of my favorite professors. He's entertaining, incredibly kind, and has a clear passion for mathematics. The homeworks were long, but not too difficult. Most of the course is review from AP Calc BC.

Prof Cepparo is obviously really passionate about math and cares a lot for his students, but the course itself is difficult to keep up with. He takes a long time to return grades and there is a lot of homework due weekly.
reviews.rating_tags: Lots of homework--Graded by few things--Caring

reviews.comment: So Dr. Cepparo is a great professor. However, his homeworks in this class are long, they take a couple hours every week. The textbook he uses in this class is great. Dr. Cepparo teaches well, but some of the test content doesn't come from his lectures but it comes from files in the modules instead. Otherwise, he is very lenient, nice, and caring.
reviews.rating_tags: Lots of homework--Get ready to read--Amazing lectures

reviews.comment: Professor Cepparo is one of my favorite instructors I have taken a class from. He is inspirational and really works to make sure students understand how concepts apply to various fields. The only negative is in the course structure forcing you to learn multivariable quickly due to the focus on series. Additionally the homework is heavy but helpful.

Took M408D. His lectures were pretty good and funny. But theres a lot of hw every week (handwritten textbook hw AND Quest every week). Overall pretty decent professor and class except for the workload.
Really funny, the tests are soooo straightforward, but there's a lot of homework - 3 written sections + 20 question quest weekly
his class has nothing to do with the homework or exams. very hard to learn in this class and no one has any idea what's going on.
reviews.rating_tags: Lots of homework--Get ready to read

reviews.comment: Cepparo is very good for Calculus (M408D). He has extra documents in Canvas for practice. He is also very patient and likes questions during office hours and Zoom lectures. Quest and written homework every week and no quizzes!

Dr. Cepparo was a good instructor for M 408D for Fall 2020 during online class, so I can't speak to how he conducts his class after this. His lectures were very clear and the example problems he worked were very helpful for understanding the material. The homework was significant, but it prepared me for the (easier) tests. Very good prof.
reviews.rating_tags: Lots of homework--Clear grading criteria--Amazing lectures

reviews.comment: Took class during Fall 2020 semester. Cepparo understands the online situation during the COVID-19 Pandemic. Lot of weekely homework assignments (Quest & Textbook) (graded holistically); be prepared to work. Prep for exams during class was mediocre. However, lectures are quite boring and the exams are unnecessarily difficult and weighted greatly.
reviews.rating_tags: Lots of homework--Get ready to read--So many papers

reviews.comment: Professor Gustavo was very good for this course. We had 5 tests, 5 projects and 11 homework assignments. He broke concepts down in detail and went over proofs of the most important theorems for Math Stat. The homework, extra examples in Canvas and projects provided practice for tests.

Lectures were informative. Fair exams and long homework assignments. Professor Gustavo is clear during lectures, but I found that going over the Zoom lectures and redoing examples and concepts from class made me understand and finish the homework faster. This class is not easy. I had to look back at my notes from M362K.

He's a good professor for review, since M408D overlaps with AP Calc BC a lot. I had a bit of trouble when he introduced new material though. He assigns an excessive amount of textbook problems. However, tests were open note and WAY easier than the homework (definitely overprepared), and we had all day to do them, too.
reviews.rating_tags: Lots of homework--Accessible outside class--Participation matters

reviews.comment: I really enjoyed Dr. Cepparo's lectures since he gave many examples and real-world applications. He also posted prior year's notes covering many of the harder concepts, which was great practice. While homework was lengthy, it was very helpful for exams. He was also super helpful during office hours and caring towards how COVID affected students.

Dr. Cepparo is very nice and accommodating to his students. You are graded based on homework (textbook & Quest), 4 tests, and 1 final. While there were a lot of homework, the problems were helpful towards the tests and final. Dr. Cepparo's lectures were also very helpful and enjoyable to attend (even at 8 AM)! Overall, he is an amazing professor!

Applied Regression and Time Series (M349R) was a cool class. Homework every week. Two exams and a final that includes a project portion for each. We used R for homework, tests and projects. Very nice professor. Clear lectures with great examples and extra files in Canvas.

I learned a lot in mathematical statistics. Gustavo is patient and repeats the concepts. Very informative lectures, but you need to read and supplement the Zoom lectures with his extra examples from Canvas and the text. The homework takes time and we have homework every week. I liked all the connections the professor made in class.
reviews.rating_tags: Respected--Accessible outside class--Get ready to read

reviews.comment: I wouldn't recommend taking this class if you've never used R before. Every homework needs R and I struggled a lot in the beginning because of this. Homework can take a long time, so start early. His exams this semester are just longer homework. You have a few hours to work on it after he posts the exam, then you turn it in on canvas.
reviews.rating_tags: Lots of homework--Get ready to read

reviews.comment: Professor Cepparo was a great math stats professor! We had weekly homework that was challenging but manageable, and he would walk through problems if you went to office hours. The tests were around the same difficulty level as the homework, and he prepared us well for them. Really caring professor (he loves stats!)

Cepparo is super understanding of the online situation and is receptive to students' needs. There's a lot of weekly homework (textbook & quest), but they prepare you well for the tests. Fair grading scale, gives partial credit on exams. If you took Calc BC, most content will be in-depth review.
Nice instructor. The exams are fair and they are a Test (70%) and Project (30%) combination. Lectures are very informative and help with the homework. Homework every week, but no quizzes.

Professor Cepparo is a lot of fun in class! His tests have been very fair so far. We use R to run simulations for projects, but it is not expected that you know how to code. I would definitely take one of his classes again.

This professor gives a tremendous amount of homework: online homework plus about 15 - 20 book problems per section, that is bout 45-60 book problems per week plus 20 - 26 online problems in a week. Tests are easy. Lectures are not good. He does not cover all the content. He solves the easiest problems in lecture, so you have to figure out the rest.
The most lively and fun professor I have ever had. He occasionally gets a little behind by giving more examples but his lectures are clear and easy to follow. The material is explained well.

Gustavo is a fun professor for mathematical statistics. The homework was more difficult than the exams. We had homework every week and he had office hours on M,W and F. We used R for some simulations, bootstraps and randomization tests. I'm using his notes now for courses that I'm taking this semester (nice bayesian examples).
Awesome math professor, walks through tons of examples and tells you everything you need to know to practice for the exam.

Professor Gustavo is very helpful. He has great energy which keeps the class interesting. He works hard to make the material understandable and relatable. He is very understanding of student concerns.

Professor Cepparo is very enthusiastic about the course which helps engage the class. He went at a reasonable pace, and the assignments were not too difficult but tested our knowledge. The lectures are clear and the notes he posts to his Canvas page are very helpful. He also was generous with partial credit (4 exams and a final).

It was great that the professor was so enthusiastic about the course material and about teaching students! The class was super fun and also there was lots of hard material (Challenging). He is very patient with students and knows his stuff. I am very grateful to have had the opportunity to have him for Predictive Analytics.
reviews.rating_tags: Accessible outside class--Skip class? You won't pass.--Hilarious

reviews.comment: M408D was a great experience with Professor Cepparo. Five test, homework from the book and Quest due every Friday and Sunday. Lots of homework! The exams are fair.

Professor Gustavo's Machine Learning course was very cool. Nice mix of applications and concepts. We used math stat at the beginning and a lot of linear algebra and bootstraps to explain concepts later. He loves stats and he is very funny. Lots of R for everything and Matlab once for SVD. Easy A.
Professor Cepparo is unorganized and shows up frazzled. He teaches too quickly and doesn't check to make sure we understand and stresses students out
reviews.rating_tags: Respected--Get ready to read--So many papers

reviews.comment: A double hand amputee could count on their fingers the number of times Dr. Cepparo has shown up to class on time. Tests are returned with little feedback or room to improve, but still the best option for calc.

The only reason I woke up for my MWF 8AMs. Literally a gem, hilarious man, and has really engaging lectures as well. SO MUCH HOMEWORK THOUGH!! The weekly textbook HW was generally harder than weekly Quest HW, but the tests don't get crazy difficult like the HW. 4 free response tests (no drops) and usually gives a small curve on the test grades.
reviews.rating_tags: Lots of homework--Skip class? You won't pass.--Hilarious

reviews.comment: Two assignments per week and tests are back to back Monday/Friday. He does that to give you a second chance at the same material. One of the most inspiring Professors I have ever had. The lectures are entertaining and he always brings good energy. He takes the time to point out the future applications of the material.

Cepparo is a great choice for this class. He's super energetic and funny during lectures and you can see that he really loves the subject. I found the assigned readings and homework pretty useful and the tests are pretty fair. The class was a bit disorganized at times, but he makes up for it by being super understanding and listening to students.

If you have already taken Calc BC, this class will seem like a drag due to the heavy amount of hw assigned each week. If not, the hw is helpful to prepare for the exams. Be prepared for back to back exams on Friday and Monday and little to no curve on the exams. Lectures vary in usefulness depending on the topic and he posts his notes online.

Gustavo is a caring, funny professor. The workload can build up towards the end of the semester, but he does a great job of making lectures understandable and engaging. Make sure to keep up with all of the homework and you will be prepared for the exams. The 8 am aspect was challenging, but I would highly recommend!

I had him for a MWF 8am calculus lecture and still like him at the end of it, so that's something. Attendance wasn't mandatory, but I felt like I got a lot from lectures. One (kind of lengthy) textbook hw and one quest hw per week, which took a lot of time but also prepared me pretty well for the tests. Generous with partial credit on tests.

Gustavo was such a caring prof! If you've taken Calc BC prior to this class, it is pretty much review. You have hw every week and 4 exams too! If you do your homework, you'll make As on all of the exams! If you ever need help though, talk to him! He is very sweet and funny. I went to class, did the work and asked questions & made an easy A!
reviews.rating_tags: Lots of homework--Skip class? You won't pass.--Caring

reviews.comment: Gustavo is an amazing professor that knows how to engage and teach his students very well! Lectures were at 8AM MWF, which seems pretty daunting, but were worth the challenge. The class has A LOT of homework and one quest due weekly, but if you manage your time and learn the material, you'll be fine. Go to office hours early on to avoid confusion!

Love Gustavo! This course is hard but Cepparo does his best to make it fun at 8AM. He assigns lots of homework and his testing system is a little funky (see other reviews). That being said, an A is still attainable! I'd previously only done Calculus AB but I did well. Just show up to lecture, do all the homework, and you should be fine!

Gustavo was a great professor! His lectures covered the basic material and the homework was a more in-depth version of the examples from class. His tests were challenging but manageable if you do all the homework, and he structures the class so you have two tests over the same material (one easier, one harder). Four tests total, and no quizzes.
reviews.rating_tags: Lots of homework--Skip class? You won't pass.

reviews.comment: There's lots of homework. For midterms, it'll be pretty difficult, but he provides reviews (except you must still study and practice). He's a good teacher, but the content was really fast-paced and difficult. He's one of the best calc teachers at UT, but get ready to do a lot of homework.

I love Gustavo! He is very caring, inviting (he says we all have a friendship with him :D) and passionate about what he teaches. His tests are tough, but if you do your work, attend class, study, and do all the practice tests he uploads (seriously do them they are very helpful) an A is attainable.

Mathematical Statistics was a great class with professor Cepparo. A lot of homework and 5 exams. The final had two parts (with and without laptop). I'm ready for more Statistics and Machine Learning in the Fall.
Very disorganized lecturer. His Canvas page is also a mess.
Gustavo was really a great prof. Go to his lectures and do all the homework and you'll be fine.
reviews.rating_tags: LOTS OF HOMEWORK--ACCESSIBLE OUTSIDE CLASS--Amazing lectures

reviews.comment: Great professor. He's energetic and funny. His weekly homework assignments were hard and were from the textbook. While I liked the professor a lot, I don't like his testing style. He gives two tests for each unit. Normally this helps, but I always did worse on the second one. His final involved using a R, so be prepared.
If you fail one exam, you screwed up the whole semester. That's true!
Small parts of the lectures were important, the tests contained key things he would go over. Tests were pretty easy though. Homework is tough and he grades it tough too

The best professor I've ever had. Aside from his interesting lectures and great sense of humor, it is very apparent that he is a highly revered, genuine person who cares about his students and encourages learning beyond the classroom. I would definitely recommend taking any class with him.

TONS of homework (I chegged everything lmao but it still took a lot of time) and some pretty strict grading but Cepparo is a great stats professor. U learn a lot and he definitely has inspired me to take more statistics classes in the near future!
reviews.rating_tags: Tough Grader--Gives good feedback--LOTS OF HOMEWORK

reviews.comment: He was funny and engaging enough to keep me awake most of the time for his 8 AMs. He explains things well and the assigned homework is very helpful for the tests. He is a more lenient grader and cares more about your learning.
Professor Gustavo is very funny and patient with any type of questions. The class is not easy. You need to have a recent M362K. We had 5 exams and homework every friday. He loves stats.
reviews.rating_tags: Gives good feedback--Respected--Skip class? You won't pass.

reviews.comment: Great professor! We had homework every week. Exams were ok (a little tricky). Very helpful during office hours. Also the TA was very helpful.

Tough grader and gives a lot of homework but he makes the topic very interesting. He is good at explaining and really cares about his students. Don't take this class if you're not interested in statistics because it will be hell.

Cepparo is an AMAZING teacher. He is very funny, keeps you engaged with his quirkiness and clearly has a very good grasp on the subject and can relate it very effectively. The content is difficult and the homework is by no means light, but as far as lectures go, I was excited to take notes from him. I would absolutely take another Cepparo course.
Lots of homework. Good lectures, really teaches the material well. The exams are fair. Brings a lot of energy to the morning lectures, kept me awake.

Cepparo is one of the best teachers to take for M408D. He's a good lecturer, and if you devote time to the class, and study the examples he gives you (as well as some problems from the textbook), you'll be just fine. There is A LOT of homework, so be prepared for that, but overall he makes the class fun and relatively straightforward.

He was very funny and patient in class and during his office hours. Attendance was mandatory with a participation grade. We worked on proofs and he made comments on applications to computer science. The exams were fair. The textbook is pretty good. There is lots of homework with problems not found in the text.

The material in Multivariable Calculus was difficult. Gustavo was a great professor and explained the material with very nice examples (not easy examples). During exams I remembered thinking of the examples giving in lecture. We had 4 exams (13.5 % each) and a final (30%). Homework was 8% and Quest was 8%

Super funny, charismatic, and wants everyone to succeed. No matter how dumb a question, he will attempt to understand and not ridicule. The class seemed to partly lose direction at the end, and most of the studying we did outside of class. There is a LOT of homework. Tests are very fair; you have to work for it. He makes 8AM lively!

Don't take him... he gives 2 midterms administered in 2 parts on Friday and Monday, which can be absolutely miserable since they are weighted so heavily. His examples in class are often left half finished since he believes you should be able to finish it, and he tends to avoid explaining the math and relying on examples to get you to catch on.

Though Mathematical Statistics was a tough course, Cepparo made it more than manageable. In my opinion, go to class, study hard, and you won't even need the book. Cepparo is always open to help and genuinely cares about your success. Would definitely recommend.
reviews.rating_tags: Skip class? You won't pass.--LECTURE HEAVY--Would take again

reviews.comment: I was enticed by positive reviews and promises of a moderately difficult class. Don't make the same mistake I did. The amount of homework you receive in this class is beyond unreasonable. Two midterms and a final, all of which are a nightmare, will ensure a bad time. He's a really nice and funny guy but a horrible grader. Take someone else.
reviews.rating_tags: Tough Grader--LOTS OF HOMEWORK--ACCESSIBLE OUTSIDE CLASS

reviews.comment: He's really energetic, funny, and passionate for teaching his subject. He's also a really helpful and good teacher and his notes/lectures are easy to understand. Homework can feel like a lot sometimes, but it really helps when it comes to his tests. The only thing I really disliked was that there were only three tests the entire year.

Mathematical Statistics is really difficult, but I can't imagine having taken anyone else for this class. Lectures were really clear and he was always willing to help students. The tests were thorough and a little tricky at times, but on the whole they were pretty fair. I can't begin to recommend him highly enough.

Although I loved having Gustavo as a professor, and felt like he taught the information in the course very well, I just didn't enjoy the set up of the course. There are 2 midterms and one final. If you do badly on one you are pretty screwed over for the rest of the semester.
reviews.rating_tags: Tough Grader--Skip class? You won't pass.--Hilarious

reviews.comment: Cepparo is awesome. Clear lectures, very nice and helpful in office hours. An easy A if you study and keep up with the work. Weekly textbook assignments and quest quizzes.
I really enjoyed this class. Professor Cepparo was awesome because what we focused on in class was what was on the test.

He is so amazing. I had him for 8am calculus and I still looked forward to going to his class because I knew he would be funny. Sometimes he might say something confusing, but he has plenty of office hours and will work with you until you understand. He is amazing!!!(:

He's a great professor. Makes lectures very funny and easy to follow. He likes to not go into theory but give only examples, so if you're looking for theory I wouldn't take him. There is a lot of homework, but it is helpful and guiding and is similar to the test problems. If you do well on the homework, you'll do well on the tests!

Cepparo is hilarious! I took his class at 8am MWF  and he made it energetic and informative. His notes are organized and briefs you before exams. Expect a rather heavy load of weekly Quest and textbook homework. TA sessions aren't mandatory but you need to go to turn in your homework to be graded. Must work for an A. Most enjoyable class so far.

Cepparo brings a lot of energy to his lectures and has high interest in the subject. Despite this, some material is not explained in the clearest way. I strongly suggest doing additional problems/reading in the book to fully understand the material and do well on the tests. Also use his office hours. He wants you to do well. Tests have a curve.

Cepparo was amazing. I loved every second of his class. He gave a lot of homework, but it really helped me tremendously. I had taken calculus before, so it was pretty easy for me and I made an A on every test. He is very willing to help and loves his students. Take this guy, you won't regret it.

Definitely not an easy class, but Cepparo is a fantastic teacher. His explanations in class were clear, although he did run through material very quickly so it was difficult to keep up at times. There's one book assignment and one quest per week, so workload is a bit heavy. I had only taken Calc AB prior, but I did all the work and made an A.

Gustavo is a great instructor and teaches with a lot of enthusiasm. I received a C in the class, but that was my own fault. The class moves very, very fast so if you don't keep up, you can into a very deep hole. Kinda wish I had taken Davis instead since she's easier.

CEPPARO IS AWESOME!!! If you do and understand his homework, study his online material, go to class, and go to his office hours for questions, you WILL do well.  He is a very generous grader and cares about his students alot.  This is also a fantastic class to take if you must take an 8AM! Very funny! Very entertaining! He made Calculus amazing!

BEST PROFESSOR I HAVE EVER HAD. Cepparo is extremely entertaining during his lectures, which are very structured, and always makes jokes to keep you interested and awake. Also, he is very patient with his students and very receptive to questions. He gives a lot of homework and if you do it, you'll get the practice you need to do well on the tests.
He clearly knew what he was teaching. However, the class is very quickly paced so stay on top of things!!!

The class is fast paced so it definitely becomes a struggle to stay with it if you happen to miss a few days of class. Cepparo teaches well and does help you grade wise. He won't blatantly tell you he will curve a grade but he always gave points back. Stay on top of the material and it is definitely a manageable class.

Weekly Quest and written homework assignments (10% of total grade each, 20% total). Each exam is 2 parts - half on Friday and half on the following Monday (I found this to be significantly stressful). Only 2 exams (not including final), so one bad grade will hurt. No calculators or notecards on any exams. Exams were lengthy and rather difficult.

If you screw up just one of his exams, you grade will be affected. So beware! I had 3 tests overall and though I improved from 66% to 96% to 104% (you see how good that improvement is), I could not make an A. :'( Work from the beginning. BTW he stammers on one phrase (always): OK WITH THAT? lol. And he loves coffee.

Cepparo is a lot of fun to listen to, and is incredibly friendly and high energy. His class was a healthy level of challenging and if you do all of the homework, attend class, and work hard, you'll come out with an A.
Good sense of humor and overall great teacher. Only thing is his tests are pretty difficult, study hard and do all the homework and you should do well in his class.
Great professor and was very well at breaking things down.  Exams were difficult, but what can you expect from a Calculus 2 course.

I love gustavo. He's super funny and cool. He makes really good analogies. He's pretty clear, and the TA's are good and so although the class material is quite difficult, you have the tools you need to succeed. The textbook is pretty good too. Workload is pretty average and he grades easily. One of the best calc professors at UT.

I survived because of my study group. Each quest question only gets 1 attempt or you miss 10 points. Check examples online. Wolfram Alpha is your new best friend. TA was occasionally helpful. Don't miss class, it'll really hurt. If you study hard, you can make it.

His accent is alright- i could deal with it temporarily. The HWs are due on Thursday so it gives you plenty of time to check over and do them. The tests are ridiculously hard and graded in a tough manner (unless the TA grades them). Overall I'm satisfied but I highly suggest anyone who took AP Calculus BC in HS to take M408C .
Easy to understand despite his accent. Very entertaining and great professor, recommend to anyone.
awesome teacher! he is sincerely interested in his students doing well..just go to class, take notes, and you'll be fine. he allows us an 8x11 cheat sheet for every test and TWO for the final
Gustavo did a good job.  We had 3 test, homeworks and a class project.  The homeworks took a long time.  Very useful applied stat course.  He uses the R program.
Very good class. He has a good teaching style and he is a people person. Explains everything very clear with lots of examples. The first argentine I liked...joke!

Great class. He is very clear and makes statistics fun. We used SAS and R all the time in class and homeworks. The homeworks are long (lots of writting) and interpreting computer output. Now I suffer from SAS addiction.
I had Cepparo for Calc 1. He really cares and explains everything very clear. He also knew everyones names in a lecture hall??

Absolutely loved her and respect her so much. The lectures are very interesting and occasionally gives you bonus points. No homework , each exam weighs 20% but the lowest out of the 5 gets dropped. Very easy class as long as you watch the lecture and read the assigned chapters. I loved this class and literally aspire to be Dr.Meston.
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--EXTRA CREDIT--Amazing lectures

reviews.comment: I really enjoyed Dr. Meston's lectures as it was clear she was passionate about the subject and easy to listen to. The lectures were even better in 2x speed and easy to digest. The information isn't for everyone but it was interesting and lots of extra credit plus a pretty straight forward test, no final, and drops lowest test score.

Super easy free A, but only graded on 5 tests. She provides bonus points opportunity in almost every lecture to bump your grade up 10 points. Attendance not mandatory. Really nice professor who's knowledgable about the class and lectures themselves had interesting topics.
SLAYYYYY. We LOVE Dr. Meston!!!
Definitely the most interesting class I've taken. Attendance isn't mandatory, but there are questions for bonus points and the lectures are worth attending.

Funniest class I have taken to this day. With that said it is actually kind of difficult so make sure you attend the lectures. If you attend lectures you will not only get EC opportunities but you will also get at least a B. I made the mistake of not going to class for half the semester and it killed me on half the tests.

This was one of my favorite classes I've taken at UT! The lectures are super interesting and the required reading is relevant and easy to digest. The tests are not hard and cover exactly what is discussed in lecture. You can also earn bonus points by logging into lectures at the scheduled times. Very engaging and an easy A if you do the work.

Easy A! If you need an SBS credit take her online class. 10 bonus points offered (on your test grades) through bonus questions every class instead of attendance. Very interesting class and glad I took it. TA's are great too!

Dr. Cindy Meston is so fun. She is so passionate about the course material and it really helped me learn everything we were talking about. Her lectures kind of run a little long sometimes, but it helps the material is interesting. The grading is phenomenal, you just gotta score pretty high on 4 tests and you're good. Also she has extra credit.

Grade entirely based on 5 tests and lowest one is dropped. Attendance is not mandatory but if you watch the lectures sometimes they give bonus questions for extra credit points. Tests are 50 questions each and you don't really need to watch the lectures but if you do you'd have a fun time the professor is very kind and interesting. Loved.
reviews.rating_tags: EXTRA CREDIT--Test heavy--Graded by few things

reviews.comment: She is an amazing person and so respectable in her field. The only grades are 5, 50 question exams with EC questions during lecture times. Exams are fair based on lecture material and assigned readings of her book. Highly recommend taking this class!

Probably the easiest class to earn your behavioral studies core requirement. Lectures are super interesting and the tests are easy if you watch the lectures. Dr. Meston is great at explaining and very passionate.
Super interesting and fun class, it's definitely a lot of reading but it is manageable. Dr. Buss and Dr. Meston were both great

Dr. Meston was a fantastic professor. No homework or assignments (only tests which are done online as the class is online). She is very funny and knows how to explain where it's interesting for us. Tests are slightly difficult but manageable if you pay attention/do the readings (theres a lot of reading). Overall very great class would take again.

Grade is made up of four exams (lowest is dropped) and extra credit received during the recorded, online lectures. Dr. Meston is a great lecturer but the only issue was not knowing how the exams would look. There are specific questions from the textbook, so be sure to read and note important info.
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--Amazing lectures --Graded by few things

reviews.comment: Meston is one of my favorite professors at UT. She makes class entertaining while staying knowledgeable. This class is lecture-heavy, but I never felt bored listening to her speak. I would highly recommend taking this course.

very manageable if you take notes on lecture (attendance not mandatory except for bonus points bc all lectures are recorded) and read the textbook... grades are 5 exams and the lowest is dropped. exam questions are super specific to lecture and textbook, so just make sure you take really good notes but overall i recommend this class to everybody.

The professor is fine but doesn't do much to help in class. There is no review for the test and you only have an hour to do 50 super specific questions about the lectures. The questions and answers are written very specifically and hard to complete in the time they allow you. There are no other grades besides the test.

LOVE this class!! Dr. Meston is awesome and her lectures are so fun to watch. I genuinely learned so much. Attendance is not required while watching the lectures but you will need to if you want a good grade. No homework, just tests but very easy if you pay attention. Take this class if you can!! Super interesting.

I took her with Dr. Buss and I loved her lectures. They were fun and had a good time. This class is very exam-heavy there is no homework just lectures and readings. You WILL have to read for this class to pass and you WILL have to watch the lectures. One exam gets dropped and the four other exams are worth 25%. I highly recommend this class.

Consists of 5 exams with the lowest grade dropped. Class requires two books, but I rarely read it and was still able to pass. As long as you pay attention to lectures, you'll get a good grade. Professor Meson is very passionate about her work & super friendly!
reviews.rating_tags: Amazing lectures --Test heavy--Graded by few things

reviews.comment: Dr. Meston is an incredibly passionate and amazing educator, I highly recommend her and Dr. Buss. This course is lecture heavy and you need to read the textbook in order to pass the exams. The content itself is pretty easy to digest. Overall this was one of my favorite courses I took at UT.
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--Amazing lectures --Lecture heavy

reviews.comment: She is very good at explaining concepts and the supporting materials she uses build on the information she shares. I will say the exams in this course specifically (psy 306) are more about details, although there are some questions about concepts.
reviews.rating_tags: Test heavy--Graded by few things--Online Savvy

reviews.comment: Professor Meston is passionate and brings spunk to her lectures! You can pretty much do the basics (watch the lectures, read the books, and refresh info before tests) to do well. Often times the test questions were straightforward, with a few being application based. I would have loved to take her class in person, but it wasn't bad online!
reviews.rating_tags: EXTRA CREDIT--Amazing lectures --Graded by few things

reviews.comment: This class was so fun. You have to read two books that they have written and they are honestly so interesting so it was an easy read. The tests are kinda specific, and those are the only thing you are graded on, but very doable if you pay attention. They also offer up to ten bonus points given during lecture. Highly recommend this class.

I liked how Meston & Buss would ask questions to each other while the other was teaching. It really encouraged a scholarly stance on taking in new information. The required readings reiterate a lot of the things in lectures, but they're definitely needed for the exams. I learned lots of interesting things that I never would have learned on my own.

Dr. Meston is an amazing professor! She is very engaged in her work/teaching and the course content is super interesting. Make sure to attend lectures for those bonus points!! (10 possible), read the books, and you'll do amazing.
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--Participation matters--Amazing lectures

reviews.comment: If you read, attend the lectures, and study for the exams you will do great in this class. I believe if I made more time to study I would have gotten an A.
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--Amazing lectures --Graded by few things

reviews.comment: Menston is one of my favorite prof's to date, she shares so many interesting stories in class and I always found myself laughing in lectures. I highly recommend this class as it was one I always looked forward to. Exams are specific and there are a lot of required readings but don't let that be the reason holding you back from the course,

The lectures were very interesting! Lectures are recorded so you can go back and watch them if you miss them. The tests are pretty specific and are the only assignments, so definitely take notes on the lectures and readings. That said, they drop your lowest grade and have in-class quizzes for extra credit, so you'll be fine if you put in the work.

Shes really sweet and kinda funny. lectures are really interesting. You need to read their books but honestly I kinda enjoyed it cuz you learn weird stories and sex facts. I end up leaving lectures to tell my friends about the interesting stuff i learned. Shes really cool and keeps lectures flowing but its not requires. exam based

Dr. Meston is hands down the best professor this school has to offer. She is brilliant, kind, and her lectures are absolutely captivating. I found she approached very controversial topics with sensitivity and grace. I would recommend her one hundred times over as an instructor.

I'm a senior and this was my favorite class I've taken at UT. Dr. Meston is the best professor ever! She is so knowledgeable in her field and makes the lectures so interesting and understandable. She cares a lot about her students and was happy to meet with me several times outside of her regular office hours. She is truly an inspiration to me.

This class was really interesting and sparked me wanting to pursue this field. No one talks about this stuff, and it was great to finally have information from an expert Cindy Meston. She was kind and caring and talked with me to encourage me to keep going.

Dr. Meston is by far my favorite professor. I learned so much in her course and appreciate the topics she taught - to put it simple, she's brilliant. I wish she was teaching another course this semester because I loved her class. Her experience makes her stand out from lots of profs who just teach stuff they don't really know about. Recommend 100%.

I took intro to human sexuality and this class was awful. The professors were completely inaccessible and didn't care about the students at all. The exams asked questions on the smallest details that were barely mentioned in lecture. The groupme was literally hating on the class all semester and saying how we wished we took literally anything else.

She uses a lot of outdated language, especially during the unit where we discussed Sexuality. It can (and was) triggering for a lot of students, including me. Honestly; the awesome students made the class for me.
reviews.rating_tags: Lecture heavy--Graded by few things--Accessible outside class

reviews.comment: It's a privilege to have two of the most notable psychologists teach a single course. Their lectures are really engaging & packed with information. The way I see & think about sex has completely changed. My mind will never be the same. As a McCombs student, I actually enjoyed this course a lot. Definitely recommend for everyone to this class.

Dr. Meston is hands-down my fav professor. The only bad thing about this class is that it isn't in-person but if you meet her or if you're even just watching the lectures, you will see how passionate and knowledgeable about this subject. Even the readings are interesting. As long as you pay attention (which she makes easy), you can get an A.

Dr. Meston & Buss are two are the funniest & knowledgeable professors I've seen. The way they talk about sex is unusual (in a good way). Just listen closely to the lectures & read the books to pass the class.

While the course content is interesting, Dr. Buss and Meston are simply not good professors. They use research from the early 2000's and their lectures are *at least* four semesters old. They are definitely the most unaccommodating professors I have ever had and use their " one free exam drop" as an excuse for missing an exam due to poor health.
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--Test heavy--Graded by few things

reviews.comment: She is engaged and accessible to students. Interesting subject matter.

FABULOUS professor!  I'd say she's the best instructor I've ever had!  She is SO knowledgeable and helps students really understand the information.  The topics are fascinating and meaningful and Dr. Meston really makes the class enjoyable!

I loved this class and loved learning from Dr. Meston. She has inspired me and my future career.  She goes above and beyond for her students and is the type of professor other professors should strive to be.  The university is luck to have her!

Dr. Meston is an icon.  She is incredibly knowledgeable and accomplished.  She communicates and lectures in a way that students get excited by the material and connected to the subject.  She deeply cares about her students and helps and supports them well beyond graduation.  She is competent, professional, and the best instructor I've ever had.

Dr. Meston is one of those professors that makes you really passionate about the subject just by her enthusiasm in the lectures. She is very educated on the content she is teaching, makes her classes fun for everyone, and lays out the content very clearly. Would highly recommend taking a class she teaches!
I don't recommend this class to anyone. Felt like a dog walking myself the whole time. AWFUL
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--Lecture heavy--Graded by few things

reviews.comment: Dr.M's lectures are consistently engaging and informative; you can tell how knowledgeable she is, and she is always more than happy to talk with her students. Speaking with her during her office hours, I was amazed at how much she cares about her students. Her enthusiastic attitude and genuine passion for the field make her a standout professor.

It was an absolute honor to take a class taught by Dr. Meston. Dr. Meston is extremely knowledgeable and respected in her field. It was so fun to learn from someone who really knows what they are talking about and who has made so many contributions to the field themselves. If you are on the fence, I really recommend taking this class!

I love Dr. Meston, she is funny and so knowledgeable in her field. I left this class learning so much about human sexuality and women's sexuality and the textbooks required for this class are actually interesting to read!
Dr. Meston is the best professor I ever took at UT Austin. She made a huge impact on my career choice and my life path.

Dr. Meston is a wonderful Professor who is a true expert in her field. Her lectures are extremely interesting, well-structured, and very comprehensive. The amount of material covered in class is immense and students really yield all possible benefits from taking, participating, and engaging in her class.
An interesting course taught by a highly respectable and semi-quirky professor. I loved this course, I wish I couldve seen Dr. Meston lecture in-person.
reviews.rating_tags: Graded by few things--Test heavy--Lecture heavy

reviews.comment: this class is by far my most favorite class at UT. The lectures are interesting and Dr. Meston had been a great speaker. The textbooks (which are 2 books written by the professors) are not like regular textbooks, they can also be good reading material even if you're not in this class.

Dr. Meston was a very good lecturer, and I learned a lot from her class. However, your grade is only made up of 4 exams. It's important to take detailed notes and prepare for very specific exams. There is no extra credit, but if you listen to the lectures and take detailed notes, a good grade is easily attainable.
reviews.rating_tags: Graded by few things--Test heavy--Amazing lectures

reviews.comment: Dr. Meston and Dr. Buss are phenomenal professors. Their lectures are very engaging, and they are clearly very knowledgeable. It's not extremely easy, but definitely doable. I got a 91.5 in this class which is barely an A, by just watching all the lectures and taking notes. You take 5 exams, and your whole grade is made up of the 4 highest grades.
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--Graded by few things--Hilarious

reviews.comment: I took the asynchronous version of PSY306 and absolutely enjoyed it. The material was actually very interesting, it's just that the tests were extremely specific (so be prepared for that). Dr. Meston (and Dr. Buss) are great professors and I absolutely recommend taking PSY306 with them.

Meston is a good and entertaining professor, and Id take her again. However the online psy306 class, while good, the grades are entirely based on 5 multiple choice exams (lowest dropped) which can have some tricky, peripheral, and confusing questions. I have a B in this class even though even though I am doing the work/studying & should have an A.

Dr Buss and Dr Meston taught a super interesting class together. There were a lot of lectures and it seemed like we had tests every other week but as long as you take detailed notes the tests are not too hard. I learned so much and am actually going to miss their class! They are both very knowledgable and fun to listen to.

I took this class during the pandemic and it was asynchronous which was nice but if you don't keep up with the lectures you're gonna fall real behind. Make sure to take really good notes because the exam questions are very specific. Class is pretty chill and all the info is interesting so you won't get bored.

Make sure to watch all lectures, do your book readings, and watch the additional videos as it all comes up on the tests. Take detailed notes and you will be fine! The whole class is very interesting so it shouldn't be too hard. The professors are both very funny and they definitely know what they are talking about. Definetely recommend!

I was very disappointed in this course as the professors constantly blur the lines between correlation and causation, present psychology as being a soft science, don't recognize viewpoints contradicting their own, and basically justify the use of eugenics. This class is disgusting if you want human sexuality then take EDP350L.

Class (completely asynchronous) is interesting but not easy. Meston is a great professor and explains in detail with Buss. It is easier to understand Meston's videos. Each unit there's 30ish video lectures (MUST watch them or you'll fail) +additional chapters (some are quite long). The grade is just 4 exams (closed note) but the q's are SO specific
reviews.rating_tags: Lots of homework--Get ready to read--Lecture heavy

reviews.comment: Dr. Meston is VERY knowledgable about women's sexuality. She made lectures very engaging and interesting, and it was fun to hear about her clinical experience (lab experiments and fun stories). The assigned readings were a lot but worth it for the knowledge gained from this class. This was one of my favorite classes and was easy. Highly recommend!
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--Skip class? You won't pass.--Amazing lectures

reviews.comment: Dr Meston was an alright professor, but a lot of work is required to get an A in this class. You have to read over all your notes before tests to pass this class. There are quizzes almost every class and missing them means a zero in the grade book. They're all four questions, so simply missing one gives you a 75 for that quiz.
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--Test heavy--Amazing lectures

reviews.comment: Her class is so interesting and her lectures are really easy to follow as long as you show up. Her tests can be a little difficult but as long as you stay on top of the homework you will be fine. I would definitely recommend any classes with her!

Dr. Meston is by far one of the best and well informed professors that I've had the pleasure of learning from. Human Sexuality is a very interesting course and should be given a try. Because the course material seems common sense, some don't study enough and make a grade that's less than what they want. Easy though

Dr. Meston is an incredible professor. She really takes the time to make sure everyone is understanding the material. It's also just a fun class. Human Sexuality has so many components that you don't even realize until she breaks it down. She's one of the best professors I've had at UT and has inspired me to pursue a career in sexual health.

Dr. Meston is one of my favorite professors so far! She gave interesting and engaging lectures, genuinely shows passion for what she teaches, and she keeps class fun and interesting while still delivering the material. Dr. Meston lectures in a way that makes you want to listen and learn. Even the textbooks are interesting and 100% worth the read!

Dr. Meston is one of the best psychology professors I have ever taken a class with. She is knowledgeable, passionate, and humorous during lectures, which makes the class material even more interesting to learn. You need to do the readings to do well in the class, but the books are written by the professors and easy to get through!

Dr. Meston is an amazing and inspirational professor. Not only is she extremely knowledgeable and well-respected in her field, she is a lovely human being and loves interacting with students. The exams are tricky, so you need to watch the lectures and do the readings to get an A. Luckily the content is super interesting, and she is hilarious!

Dr. Meston is a wonderful professor. In and outside of class, she speaks with clarity and poise. She is very knowledgeable about the work in her field and presents information in a way that encourages learning. She is very accessible, and she encourages academic growth. In addition to this, it is clear that she cares about her students' success.

Really sad this class ended. Dr. Meston is a very, very established professor. As a sophomore, this class was definitely my favorite class I've taken in college before. I was always interested by her and Dr. Buss's lectures; they make a great team. Thank you! Also, highly recommend taking it online.

Human sexuality was so interesting. The "textbooks" are books written by the professors that are incredibly interesting. Literally all you talk about is sex, mating strategies, and a whole lot of interesting stuff related to it. By far my favorite class this semester.

I took Intro to Human Sexuality and I was so sad when the class ended. Dr. Meston and Dr. Buss are amazing professors. These two are hilarious together and have so much knowledge in their respective fields. Tests aren't tough if you study and read. Pop quizzes aren't difficult either if you have a basic understanding of the material.

Best class ever! Dr. Meston is a true inspiration and her class is super organized and fun! You'll never be bored in lecture, will have pop quizzes (which are very predictable), her book is a great read, and the class is very informational. YOU MUST TAKE THIS CLASS!
Her classes were OK. Exams were tough averages would be 77 or 82 and shed be like wow class great average! Didn't expect this class lowering my grades.

Intro to Human Sexuality Psychology! Dr. Buss and Dr. Meston are amazing! This class is great, it's online but don't fear because the lectures are really interesting and the information is always provided (slides, transcripts, etc.) There are pop quizzes but they are super easy, you don't have to study for them as long as you pay attention!
Great professor, funny and does important research.
Dr. Meston was absolutely fantastic, and I would highly recommend Human Sexuality to anyone considering it. The class is very interesting and entertaining, and I learned a great deal.

Dr. Meston was one of my favorite professors. She is easy going and very passionate about her field. That being said, she teaches with absolute clarity. She makes class fun and helps create situations in which you want to participate. Her tests and fair and not tricky. She is a wonderful professor and I would recommend her class to everyone.
Great teacher!  Great topic!  Suggest to all!

I took her online class with Dr. Buss and it was amazing.  I can say this was one of the best psychology classes I've taken, I definitely recommend it. The topics covered in the class are extremely interesting and well complemented by the research she has done.

Dr. Meston taught this class with Dr. Buss and was probably the most interesting class I've taken at UT. Obviously it is a sensitive topic but all of our discussions were very open and scientifically based. There would be times when we'd answer poll questions and those were always super entertaining. It's a challenging course but so interesting!!

Human Sexuality was one of the most interesting psychology courses I took during my time at UT.  Read the books, get the most out of this class, one of the leading researchers on women's sexuality and there is so much to learn from her. After taking this class I was so excited that I just had to apply for an RA position in her lab.

Dr. Meston's class was incredibly interesting and I always loved attending. She is a wonderful professor who explains everything clearly and takes the time to answer all questions. She does a great job of integrating different forms of media into her lectures which keeps the (already interesting) topic even more enjoyable.

I took Dr. Meston's Human Sexuality class and absolutely loved it. Her lectures were incredibly interesting, the books assigned were fun and helpful, and she was well prepared and engaging. It is not an easy A class, but if you want to learn about human sexuality, it's well worth the effort. Dr. Meston is an admirable woman and professor.

I took Dr. Meston's human sexuality class and found her to be incredibly knowledgeable and a really effective prof. She is funny and kind and always available to discuss class content and answer questions. She's tough but fair and pushes her students to think conceptually about important topics. She is the best professor and UT's lucky to have her.

Dr. Meston gives awesome lectures, asks great questions, and never fails to give clarification when she makes something seem obscure. Though the exams may seem tough at first, as long as you study well and do the readings, you can easily make an A. Though it is important to read the book, most topics in the readings are discussed in class as well.

Dr. Meston is one of my favorite professors. She is very knowledgeable and enthusiastic about her course material but also very nice and approachable.  She makes her lectures fun and interesting while also providing all the information you will need for future exams and for comprehension of the subject material. Would definitely recommend her class
She is mart and funny, obviousLy well prepared, and engaging.  Really interesting Material.  Tests are challenging.

Lectures were live & online, more of a talk show, discussion between her & Dr. Buss, hard to decipher what was relevant and what were tangents they went off on. Research presented in class hardly qualifies as credible, & many time equates correlation with causation. Exams are ambiguous with multiple correct answers, but you must choose most correct

The Psychology of Sex class was very informative but lacked in some structure areas. The exams were fair but had typos and wording issues. The class has 4 exams worth 25% each of the grade. She is a good lecturer and tries to relate the information back to the real world.

Everyone is expecting an easy A since the class was directly taken from the other one of her class "human sexuality". But everyone is wrong . The tests are absolutely retardedly ambiguous and impossible to answer.

She is by far one of my favorite teachers I've had in my Psychology classes! I recommend Human Sexuality with her to everyone. I found that if you print of the notes, which she provides on blackboard, add to them in class, and read the book, it's not a difficult class. She is funny and definitely keeps you engaged and interested!

Class was interesting and entertaining overall, but had a lot of bio and overlap with certain sections of Abnormal. I found the tests to be very difficult. It seems she pulls very obscure and arbitrary details like things she said in lecture that aren't even in the slides or out of the footnotes of the book - i.e. all around hard to study for.

They are such an amazing professor! Super kind and welcoming. They provide super insightful lectures as well. Genuinely learned so much but in a fun and interactive way. Would 100% take again. There are exams and a good amount of writing assignments but they're pretty simple! Attendance is not required 100% of the time, but often.

Cizsek is the sweetest; you can tell they care about their students and teaching the material. This class wasn't difficult at all either. Def don't hesitate to take this class if Cizsek is still the professor!

Although I ended with a C (totally on me because I completely missed a quiz), Professor Cizsek had such great lectures that really helped with understanding the field of advertising and it was a really easy class

Love love loved this class. Super easy with fun lectures and collaborative discussions. Dr.Cizek is clearly passionate about their profession and does their best to ensure their students are being educated about important current issues. Lots of extra credit and exams were stress free with no final
MY FAVORITE TEACHER AT UT!!!! Genuinely cares about her students and the material. Great and engaging lecture! Take her class, you will not regret it!!! Loved every minute of her lectures!

This is a great course. Dr. Sturm is very organized, and the TAs are helpful. You'll need to study for the three midterms, and there's a project too. Keep up with Instapolls, and you can easily earn an A. The only reason I didn't earn an A is because of the midterms, so watch out!

Boring pre-recorded course for flag credit. Can lose an A if you miss a handful of MC questions over the 3 exams. Skim over the main textbook (cheap, old editions work!) and assigned readings to review term definitions before exams. Don't need to study too much outside of video lectures. TAs are good.
reviews.rating_tags: Lecture heavy--Test heavy--Graded by few things

reviews.comment: Lectures are boring --- she just talks in circles and TA's are pretty bad (lacking basic canvas skills). Class is easy, all online prerecorded lectures with occasional instapolls. One project with a 2 page paper. There is extra credit opportunities (~2 points on final grade). Overall --- good class if you just need the credit and an easy A.

Overall pretty great professor. The course is online but she doesn't make the course more difficult because of that (as many professors tend to do). Pretty interesting takes and lectures. The grade is very focused on the tests, which are very focused on the texts so be sure to read.
reviews.rating_tags: Lecture heavy--Test heavy--Graded by few things

reviews.comment: This class had pre-recorded lectures, so it was a bit hard to stay focused. Exams were open note and flashcards were completion based. Take REALLY good notes from lectures because exam questions are pretty specific and you basically only need definitions from textbook. Also do the extra credit!! Love prof Sturm and her TAs were chill too.
reviews.rating_tags: Clear grading criteria--Graded by few things

reviews.comment: This class was relatively interesting in terms of course material. There's very few requirements for this class and any assignments/tests are manageable. Professor Sturm's lectures were informative, although sometimes a little circular. If you need this class for the flag or for a core credit, I definitely recommend it.

Dr. Strum talks in circles, her lectures tend to be boring and not coherent. They also used recycled lecture segments from a previous semester which was frankly negligent. This class is very content heavy, so only take it if you absolutely need it. One of her textbooks is completely irrelevant to the content of the class, which was vexing.

This asynchronous class was just recycled recordings from the scheduled class the semester before, so the recordings have weird tidbits telling us to type in the chat or ask questions (which is impossible). Other than that, it is a pretty easy class and there is only one real assignment.

Prof. Sturm is a great lecturer. The online lectures (which you have to watch at the scheduled time) have 2 instapolls that you should get if you pay even a little attention (I played clash royale the whole time). 
Grades are: 3 Flashcards (graded based on completion, easy 100), 3 Exams, 1 Project.
Lots of reading + exams are a large part of grade.

With Prof. Craig Campbell. Both were great! I learned a ton about Indigenous Texas and Indigenous methodologies. The course timeline could occasionally feel a little underplanned in the second half of the semester, but there's a lot of unique things they're trying out for an undergrad course. Highly recommend this class!

wouldn't recommend taking the online ANT302 unless you know a couple people in the class. lectures are generally boring, but there isn't much work to do. three midterms, worth 20% each that are slightly difficult. overall, there's definitely easier classes to take for the human behavior credit.
Professor Strum has a strong bias and is politically driven in her lectures; she imposes her liberal ideologies regarding debatable topics such as gender/sex and tests over those contents.
reviews.rating_tags: Lecture heavy--Test heavy--Graded by few things

reviews.comment: One of the best professors I've ever had. Even though we had assigned readings, she explains everything in lectures so I only used the books for term definitions. If you even pay attention to her lectures a little bit you'll pass. She always uses examples from her own experience to explain the material and it makes class so much more interesting.
reviews.rating_tags: Amazing lectures --Lecture heavy--Graded by few things

reviews.comment: Attendance is graded upon insta-poll (you'll be counted absent for the whole day if you miss one quiz question).
reviews.rating_tags: Participation matters--Lecture heavy--Graded by few things

reviews.comment: Dr. Sturm is a great prof. Her lectures are very informative and she explains topics in depth. There are many readings but I never read through the books just studied summaries and did good. She explains most of what will be on the exams during the lectures. You should succeed in this class if you take good notes and watch through the lectures.
reviews.rating_tags: Amazing lectures --Clear grading criteria--Graded by few things

reviews.comment: Cultural anthropology is an incredibly broad subject; unfortunately, that means a majority of the specific (& interesting) aspects of it cannot be covered in a single semester. In spite of the long lectures, Dr. Sturm fails to make most topics very interesting and, as a result, especially when taken online, it is difficult to keep one's focus.

Good professor.

Had engaging visit to indigenous site in Austin, class in a museum on campus, etc. They have a vast mental knowledge of the topics, and can answer almost any question you have.

I wish there was less individual writing assignments and more collective/verbal learning

She is very knowledgeable and passionate about anthro, exams are fairly easy if you take notes on her lectures and look at the main concepts in the textbook. But like others said you can only miss a few in order to keep an A. I followed the directions for the family alter assignment and got a 100, not sure what the difficulty was. Decent class
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--Amazing lectures --Test heavy

reviews.comment: The family altar paper has no grading structure and it ended up tanking my grade. You can only miss 2  questions on each exam to maintain an A. This was supposed to be my blow off class and get my GC flag credit and it ended up being the only class i didn't get an A. Should've just used Chat Gpt rather than writing my own personal life.

Unclear grading criteria on Family Altar Project; it sunk my grade so much. Lectures were very long; lots of reading that took a lot of my time. Miss just a few questions on the exams (more than 3) and say goodbye to that A. I sincerely wish this class offered extra credit.
reviews.rating_tags: Tough grader--Get ready to read--Participation matters

reviews.comment: Professor Sturm is very passionate professor who cares deeply about the lecture content. The lectures are engaging and entertaining. She does a great job making an online class feel in-person. The class is super test heavy, but its not a problem when most of the questions are conceptual. Easy course, great professor.

Since this was asynch, we had several videos of Prof Sturm as our lectures and some readings. Grade was based on 3 exams, 1 paper. I can't complain too much considering the minimal effort put in, but the exams could be a bit nuanced and although I had decent grades, I still managed an A-, since an A has a percent cutoff at 94%
reviews.rating_tags: Clear grading criteria--Lecture heavy--Graded by few things

reviews.comment: Dr. Sturm is very knowledgeable in anthropology and is clearly passionate about it. That being said, she's not the best professor. There are three midterms and one essay that make up a majority of your grade. Exams weren't bad but get ready to read multiple pages from the textbook along with assigned articles.
reviews.rating_tags: Tough grader--Get ready to read--Clear grading criteria

reviews.comment: The lectures are outdated and there is a heavy amount of required reading, and they don't match up. There are three exams and one essay. The essay was fine but did have tricky and unclear criteria. The exams are ridiculously difficult and detailed multiple-choice. Miss only a small handful of questions and your grade drops significantly.
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--Participation matters--Test heavy

reviews.comment: There was a ridiculous amount of reading and most of the time there were rarely any questions on the exams from the readings. There are only 3 major assignments and the project had unclear expectations that were not stated in the rubric. When I emailed her about it, not only was she unhelpful, she was very rude and passive-aggressive.

The lectures are jammed packed with test info and exams were often very detailed. As long as you can keep yourself motivated this course is great. The content was very interesting and can be applied to a variety of career fields. Overall great professor for an online course.
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--Clear grading criteria--Lecture heavy

reviews.comment: Exams were so detailed & difficult & if you missed more than 3 q's your grade dropped a letter. Tremendous amount of reading assigned in a short period of time. The project had poorly defined expectations and points taken off for things not even stated in the directions. Prof always had a passive aggressive tone when responding to student's msgs.
reviews.rating_tags: Tough grader--Get ready to read--Test heavy

reviews.comment: Your grade in this class is heavily dependent on 3 exams you take during the semester.
